After serving as an MSNBC contributor and guest-host on the network for four years, TV and radio personality Michael Smerconish believed he was ready to head a show of his own. CNN agreed, and thus was born `Smerconish', an hourlong Saturday morning program that takes after its host's independent views. Using a topical, conversational format, he aims for the TV show to be an extension of his weekday radio broadcast, with free-flowing topics and the ability to discuss issues that strike a chord with the audience. Along the same lines, he thinks it's important to present the content in an engaging manner, free of my-way-or-the-highway ideology. Smerconish, who has a law degree from the University of Pennsylvania, is also a New York Times' best-selling author.

Callies Vater lädt Mark auf den Landsitz der Familie ein, um dort die Feiertage zu verbringen. Mark kann fast nichts mehr überraschen, aber dennoch gefällt es ihm nicht, dass er mit Twayne einen Kampf auf Leben und Tod bestehen soll.

In South Park gehen die sogenannten Mörderpornos um. Die gefährlichen Sendungen, in denen Morde unter Eheleuten vor, während oder nach dem Sex nachgestellt werden, wirken auch auf Stans Eltern anregend.

Enttäuscht lassen sich die Southparker ihre "Was würde Jesus tun"-Armbänder entfernen, da ein Forscherteam entdeckt hat, dass Jesus nur deshalb wiederauferstehen konnte, weil er leistungssteigernde Hormone genommen hatte. Nur Stan bleibt Jesus treu.

Obama wird wieder zum Präsidenten gewählt. Doch ist dieses Wahlergebnis zweifelhaft, denn Cartman klaut die Wählerstimmen der Swing States. Die Chinesen geben ihm dafür den Auftrag, sie verlangen jedoch die Rechte an den Star-Wars-Filmen.
Henriettes Eltern kommen nur schwer damit klar, dass ihre Tochter mit Goth-Kids herumhängt. Nach einer Beratung wird entschieden, die Tochter in ein Camp zu schicken.

Cartman hat angeblich eine rothaarige Kuh mit Sommersprossen entdeckt und trägt so fast zum Weltfrieden wegen einer Weissagung der großen Religionen bei, doch Kyle durchschaut Cartmans schlechten Scherz und versucht, ihn zur Vernunft zu bringen.

Mr. Fischoeder engagiert Bob als seinen persönlichen Koch, um auf der geheimen Insel seines exklusiven Klubs einen Glamping-Trip zu machen. Währenddessen gibt Linda den Kindern einen Intensivkurs über das richtige Benehmen auf einer Cocktailparty.

Stan hat sich bisher noch keine Gedanken über den anstehenden 20. Hochzeitstag mit Francine gemacht. Roger will ihm helfen und erzählt ihr, dass Stan plant, ihr Ehegelöbnis aufzufrischen. Um herauszufinden, ob Stan sie wirklich liebt, erscheint sie zur Zeremonie ungepflegt und mit ein paar Kilos mehr auf der Waage. Als Stan jedoch darauf hereinfällt, trennt sie sich von ihm. Nun muss er sich etwas einfallen lassen, um die Liebe seines Lebens zurückzugewinnen.

Stan ist empört, als er erfährt, dass Hayley auf ein Rockkonzert gehen will. Da er felsenfest davon überzeugt ist, eine solche Musikrichtung hätte einen schlechten Einfluss auf seine Tochter, erteilt er ihr von nun an Konzertverbot. Francine teilt Stans Ansicht jedoch nicht und besorgt Hayley heimlich die Eintrittskarte für das nächste Konzert wieder. Als der Schwindel auffliegt, ist Stan außer sich vor Wut und macht sich unverzüglich auf den Weg zur Konzerthalle, um Hayley abzuholen.

Stan will Hayley gute Ratschläge für die Zukunft geben, doch seine Tochter möchte eine Art Bio-Mulch auf den Markt bringen, mit dessen Erlösen sie ein Charity-Projekt für Kinder unterstützen will. Stan dagegen plant, eine chemische Reinigung aufzumachen. Er ist von seiner Idee so begeistert, dass er mehrere Stripperinnen überredet mitzumachen, um so dem Schmuddelgewerbe zu entkommen.
Stans Ideenreichtum ist gefragt, als Francine ihn dazu auffordert, seinen spritfressenden SUV zu verkaufen, um so die Umwelt und die Familienkasse zu schonen.
Während Malcolm, von Hal unterstützt, nach einem College sucht, wohnt das frischvermählte Paar Reese und Raduca in der Garage. Nur Lois ist Raduca von Anfang an ein Dorn im Auge.
Bei einem Arztbesuch erfährt Lois, dass sie das Pfeiffersche Drüsenfieber hat. Natürlich steckt sie sofort Malcolm an, sodass beide eine Woche zusammen in Quarantäne verbringen müssen.

Lois und Hal besuchen Francis, um mit ihm den ersten Jahrestag zu feiern, seit er aufgehört hat zu trinken. Als sie ihn jedoch zu einem Treffen seiner Selbsthilfegruppe begleiten, kommt heraus, dass Francis durch Lois zum Trinken getrieben wurde.
Reese wird von vier Mitschülerinnen ein gemeiner Streich gespielt. Lois schwört den Mädchen böse Rache.

Phil schwelgt in alten Erinnerungen, als er das Lied hört, das er mit seiner ersten Freundin assoziiert. Doch dann hat er ein schlechtes Gewissen Claire gegenüber und will das Ganze ungeschehen machen. Alex merkt, dass mit ihm etwas nicht stimmt.

Als Cam und Mitch nur Zusagen für die Hochzeit bekommen, geraten sie in Zweifel, ob sie die Feier überhaupt bezahlen können. Weil er zu stolz ist, will Mitch auch Jay nicht um Unterstützung bitten. Deshalb wollen sie etwas Wertvolles verkaufen.
Das Chaos ist ausgebrochen. Mitch und Cam wenden einen Notfallplan nach dem anderen an. Doch schließlich können sie aufatmen und versuchen, den Tag zu genießen.

Alex kommt von ihrer Reise zurück. Cam schwebt nach den Flitterwochen weiterhin im siebten Himmel. Mitchell hingegen ist von seinem romantischen Verhalten mehr als genervt und will nur noch zum Alltagsleben zurückkehren.

Bender wird unverhofft zum Matador in einem besonderen Sport ernannt, dem Käferkampf. In der Arena selbst stellt er jedoch schnell fest, dass diese Sportart ihn an seine Grenzen bringt und er nicht unbedingt siegreich sein muss.

Der Professor hat ein Mutanten-Team entwickelt, um gegen die Harlem Globetrotters anzutreten. Doch sein Team verliert nicht nur, ihre Mutation führt außerdem dazu, dass die Zeit schneller abläuft und das Ende der Welt kurz bevorsteht.

Als Fry seinen Großvater 1947 vor dem Militär bewahren will, bringt er ihn versehentlich um. Damit sollte seine Existenz eigentlich enden und er verschwinden, doch merkwürdigerweise passiert nichts. Warum, erfährt er, als er seine Oma trösten will.

Die von Professor Farnsworth erfundene "Was wäre, wenn"-Maschine kommt wieder zum Einsatz. Bender sieht, wie sein Leben als Mensch wäre, Fry sieht sein Leben in einem Videospiel und Leela landet auf einem Planeten, wie aus dem "Zauberer von Oz".

Als Bender sein Techtelmechtel mit dem weiblichen Bordcomputer beendet, dreht die Dame durch. Aus Eifersucht beschließt sie, Selbstmord zu begehen und die Crew in einem schrecklichen Absturz mit sich in den Tod zu reißen.

Professor Farnsworth und Hermes wollen, dass ihre Söhne Cubert und Dwight eigenes Geld verdienen. Darum setzen sie sie auf die Straße, rechnen aber nicht mit der Reaktion ihrer Sprösslinge. Die gründen nämlich ein Konkurrenz-Unternehmen.

Als die Crew Amys Familie auf dem Mars besucht, lässt ein von den Ureinwohnern verursachter Sandsturm die Buggalo-Herde der Wongs verschwinden. Fry, Leela und Kif machen sich auf die Suche nach der Herde, doch in der Zwischenzeit wird Amy entführt.

Andy und Lou nehmen an einer Spielshow teil, ob sie wohl viele Preise abräumen werden? Vicky Pollard hat endlich einen neuen Job gefunden. Sie arbeitet jetzt bei einer Sex-Hotline. An introduction to the gang. Wedding planner Monica is driving the bride to distraction, New York is hit by its worst blizzard for 20 years, and Joey is taking his role standing in for Phoebe's incarcerated father far too seriously. Chandler and Ross are upset that neither of them has a role, until Mike needs to replace one of his groomsmen.

Monica and Chandler discover that their prospective adoptive child's biological father may be a 'shovel killer', Ross and Rachel get dangerously close when they go to visit her sick father, and Phoebe struggles to teach Joey French for an audition.

Rachel makes the mistake of going for a job interview at a restaurant where her current boss is also dining. Phoebe discovers she can change her name to whatever she likes - Princess Consuela Bananahammock seems the logical choice, until Mike proves that two can play her game - and Joey, upset that Chandler and Monica are moving, is comforted by an eight-year-old.

When Rachel makes a startling announcement, Ross secretly schemes to get her former job back for her. Meanwhile, Joey is so flustered by all the upheaval in his friends' lives that Phoebe prevents him from learning about the sudden death of his agent. Monica and Chandler make a stunning discovery after they check out the house for sale next door to their new home.

Absurd comedy about a likeable buffoon who turns the most ordinary situations into moments of excruciating embarrassment. Mr Bean rushes to his exam only to find out he's studied the wrong subject. He then goes to the beach but struggles to change into his swimming trunks discretely. Later on, he has difficulty attending a church service without drawing attention to himself.

Mr Bean goes to a swimming pool but finds himself terrified of the high diving board, afterwards, he must try several imaginative ways to get out of the car park when he doesn't have enough money to pay. He then demonstrates the proper way to make a sandwich whilst out at the park. Finally, when Mr Bean and his girlfriend go on a date to watch a horror movie he teases her for being scared until the film actually starts.

A disturbed undercover cop recovering from his wife's death is teamed up with a detective with a stable family background to crack an underground drug ring. The line between duty and off-duty begins to blur, however, when the daughter of one of the cops is kidnapped by the gun-toting heavies.
Aisha Tyler hosts the legendary improv show with Wayne Brady, Ryan Stiles and Colin Mochrie along with guest performer Brad Sherwood and star of smash hit TV series Empire, Grace Byers. (S5, E09)
The beef crisis hits South America elementary and the boys fight for their lunchtime sloppy joes. Stan struggles with Randy joining his friend group.
Vinnie Politan takes a deep dive into the true-crime stories that are captivating the world over, featuring sharp analysis and insightful interviews for a deeper understanding of these cases.
Sherri Malarik is found dead in a Winn-Dixie car park. Police suspect her husband is involved.
Ted Rowlands examines the investigation into the tragic Delphi Murders of Abby Williams and Libby German, as defence lawyers reveal behind-the-scenes insights into the case's controversial evidence.
Live gavel-to-gavel coverage, in-depth legal reporting and expert analysis of America's most important and compelling trials.

Bonny Lee Bakley had nine husbands before she met former 'Baretta' star Robert Blake, and he would be her last. As she waited for Blake outside a Los Angeles restaurant, someone approached her car and shot her in the head.
When a man is found shot dead in West Virginia, detectives piece together surveillance footage that exposes a calculated killing and leads to justice.

Albert Maughan subjected Louise and Craig Turnbull to a harrowing regime of abuse, starting from when they were only three and four years old. 24 years later, Louise decides to put this monster behind bars once and for all.

When an Atlanta-area horse trainer abruptly vanishes from his ranch, police search for the missing father-to-be, ultimately discovering a salacious secret where untamed passions may have led to the victim's untimely demise.
A young woman is found bound and strangled to death on the side of a road; as police retrace her final steps, they discover she was last seen being followed by a suspicious man in a cowboy hat.
A young pastor grieves after his wife dies in a house fire, but when shocking secrets are revealed, a community is shattered. A mysterious prophecy could perhaps have predicted her death.
A husband discovers his wife face down in their bathtub; her death appears to be an accident, but questions are raised about how she drowned.

Deanna Cremin was brutally murdered in Somerville, Massachusetts just after celebrating her 17th birthday in 1995. As police began digging into the murder of Jacquelyn Smith in Baltimore, they made a stunning discovery.
Uncover a chilling mystery as a man vanishes in 1988, leading police to a shocking serial killer hiding in plain sight.
Three brutal cold cases remained unsolved for decades until advances in forensic technology brought investigators closer than ever to finding answers.

Two cold cases, the 1992 murder of school teacher Christy Mirack in Lancaster, Pennsylvania, and the 1990 murder of Genevieve Zitricki in Greenville, South Carolina, were finally solved thanks to advancements in DNA technology.
Follow a haunting search as Sade Robinson vanishes in Milwaukee and a trail of shocking evidence leaves her family fighting for justice.
A convicted quadruple murderer argues with the judge; a pastor who stole from his church hears from his congregation; a man who murdered his grandparents becomes disorderly in the courtroom.

The judge has harsh words for a man convicted of killing his mother and her boyfriend; a woman charged with Assault and Battery takes out her frustrations on a jailhouse podium; the judge mutes a defendant who won't stop interrupting him in court.

A look at some of the wildest courtroom moments. A man accused of indecent exposure slams his head against a courtroom desk during questioning, a father takes his 19-year-old daughter to court over back rent; a woman in court for a bond violation.

The judge charges a defendant with six counts of contempt after he drops six "f-bombs" in court; a woman accused of domestic assault is unhappy with the conditions of her bond; an angry judge yells at a repeat drug offender; and more.
A judge lashes out at a defence attorney who refers to his drink-driving client as a hero; a religious leader convicted of sexual abuse hears from his victims.

A man charged with Driving with a Suspended Licence appears at his virtual hearing driving a car; the judge comes down hard on a man accused of assaulting his baby's mother; a man accused of living on someone else's land stands defiant.
A defendant strips naked; the family of a murder victim attacks.

A grieving father speaks out during a sentencing hearing; a judge has mercy on a defendant who violated their probation 17 days before it was due to end; a misinformed judge hugs a defendant he had harsh words for in an earlier hearing; and more.

A look at some of the wildest courtroom moments. The judge comes down hard on a woman found guilty of D-U-I and assaulting a police officer; a man who has pleaded no contest to assaulting his ex-wife leaves his sentencing hearing.
A judge chastises a defendant for sleeping in virtual court, a grieving mother forgives the man who killed her unborn twins, a judge gets creative when sentencing a defendant, and more.
A grieving father stares down the man who killed his daughter, a judge mutes an unruly defendant during a virtual hearing, an arsonist pleads guilty to a decades-old crime, and more.
A man is outraged after learning his bond amount, another demands a new judge, and a third disrupts his trial with multiple courtroom outbursts.

A grieving mother confronts the family of her son's killer. A woman is sentenced for eating doughnuts without paying for them. A convicted murderer is verbally confronted in court by his victim's family, and more.

A judge calls back a woman who curses and leaves a hearing. A murdered victim's father rushes a defendant in court. A wife seeks a protection order against a woman involved with her husband, and more.

A grieving man jumps over the gallery railing and goes after his brother's killer; a defendant gets his bond revoked after angering the judge; a man tries to blame spiked cake frosting for his failed blood alcohol test.
A man in a leopard print onesie is arrested for stealing from a pet store; a gas station robbery has a strange culprit; a driver arrested for DUI finds new ways to add to his rap sheet.
A woman turns shoplifting into a game of chance; a clumsy burglar botches a robbery attempt; a young driver suspected of a DUI denies guilt, but keeps chugging - in a most peculiar place.
A 911 call about cold fries leads to an arrest for murder, a fugitive is caught on the toilet, a senior citizen is arrested for robbing a bank, and more.

Celebrity hairdresser Fabio Sementilli seemed to have it all—fame, a loving family, a luxury lifestyle. But when he was found stabbed to death and his sports car stolen, detectives uncovered a chilling murder plot.
Hoping to sell a diamond ring to fund a holiday, a couple post an ad online. The transaction becomes a home invasion when assailants show up at their door.

A beloved mother is found stabbed to death in a vacant lot and, when New Orleans detectives investigate the case, their only suspect seems an unlikely killer. With the help of the victim's daughter, prosecutors fight to restore her dignity.
After a shocking attack outside her home, a West Virginia mother's case leads investigators down a disturbing path.
Tyler Hadley discusses how he, as a troubled 17-year-old, bludgeoned his mother and father to death with a hammer.
When a gang-related murder shocks East London, teenager Sam Hallam is convicted. Years later, new evidence casts doubt on the case.

Tony Godwin catfishes a predator grooming a woman to supply her 9-year-old niece for sex. Then, an offender makes a chilling admission following a tense takedown. Detectives scramble to stop a predator with access to vulnerable kids.
Joseph Z provides prophetic commentary on global events through faith-based journalism and teaching.
Join Pastors Larry and Tiz Huch from Dallas, Texas as they share revelations from the Word of God.
Renowned Christian scholar Rick Renner delves into the Greek New Testament, blending historical texts with modern illustrations to unpack God's message for His believers.
Pastor Shawn Baker challenges any and all to get closer to God and to learn how to embrace the life that He has prepared for every single person.
Bible teaching with an emphasis on prophecy, Israel and the Jewish roots of Christianity.
Stories of life, love, and hope from the mission fields of Haiti.
A religious programme fronted by Reverend Samuel Rodriguez.
The worldwide ministry of Rod Parsley and his work to revive the life of God in human hearts.
Joni and guests tackle a wide range of relevant issues, controversial subjects and hard-hitting news topics with candour and wit.
Christ in Prophecy with Dr. David Reagan and Nathan Jones deals with the prophetic significance of national and international events.
Messianic rabbi KA Schneider looks at how the Old and New Testaments are integrated, building faith and changing lives.
Rabbi Jonathan Bernis of Jewish Voice Ministries shares the lessons he learned after his miraculous health recovery.
Kenneth Copeland Ministries is a teaching ministry assigned by God to preach the gospel of Jesus Christ all around the world and without compromise in order to get the message out that Jesus is Lord.
Equipping Pastors, group leaders and church members with biblical truth and tools to heal themselves and take healing to a wounded world.
Familiar hymns and beautifully produced original music accompany Scripture to help you let go and surrender during a time of daily prayer and meditation.
Host Nancy Dufresne shares messages addressing the topics of faith, healing, renewing the mind, following the Holy Spirit and a life in Christ.
A church service including praise and worship and an inspiring message by Pastor Mac Hammond.
Travelling back into China to towns with no known Christians, missionaries Tim and Will hope to share the gospel while under tight scrutiny by local communist police.
After she is taught the theory of evolution in her biology class at university, a young Christian woman begins to drift away from her faith.

Chris Quantum is a typical middle school student, but one of his best friends is a robot named Gizmo and the other is Joy Pepper. The adventures begin for this trio when a mysterious device appears and takes them on journeys throughout the Bible.
Pastor Doug, Dusty, Amelia and characters learn about the Bible and how it applies to daily life with the help of games, songs and silly puppets.

Doug welcomes a lost puppy into his new home, but young Dusty still has some learning to do. After a major mess-up in the garden, Dusty worries Doug won't love him any more and considers running away.
Cowboy Dan teaches children some valuable life lessons.
This animated Gospel-centred series follows a group of student owls as they adventure along creatively learning about nature, faith, and God.
Heroes and heroines of Christian faith, both Biblical and contemporary.
The Scaly Adventures Crew journeys the world in search of amazing animals and incredible adventures.
Author, speaker, and mentor, Drenda Keesee wants you and your family to find happiness, live spiritually whole and prosper emotionally.

Chris Mitchell reports from one of the most explosive regions in the world. Offers a biblical and prophetic perspective to the daily news events that shape our world, with a particular focus on Israel and the Middle East.
Israel Now News is a weekly TV news magazine. It presents a unique perspective of Israel's current events, politics, and culture to an English-speaking audience.

David Dickinson and the team head to St Albans, Hertfordshire, where Janice Kehoe's eye is caught by a lamp made by a famous potter, Karen Dalmeny is intrigued by an engraved walking stick and Simon Schneider is tempted by a brass item.

David Dickinson and his team of antiques dealers visit Barrow-in-Furness, Cumbria, to help members of the public sort the treasures from their rubbish. Among the items examined are a Clarice Cliff coffee set and a collection of pocket watches.

David Dickinson travels to Coalville in Leicestershire to help members of the public find diamonds in their rough. Antiques dealers Ian Towning, Alison Chapman, James Layte and Tony Geering bargain hard to buy their favourite items, but it's a carved jade frog that's got everyone hopping with excitement.

David Dickinson and his team of antique dealers travel to Stockport to give members of the public the chance to put their valuables into auction or accept a cash sum. Brenda Haller encounters a stationery box worth writing home about; a maritime picture leaves David Hakeney awash with wonder, but it's a pocket watch and set of sovereigns that turns the den into a gold mine today.

Stockport plays host to David and his team of dealers, where David Hakeney's eyes light up for a bizarre antique lamp, Simon Schneider forecasts a battle over a barometer and Brenda Haller gets a big kick out of a rare 1920s football programme.
Join antiques expert David Dickinson as collectors try to sell their items to dealers. Will they strike a deal or take a chance at auction instead?
Les and Seth clash over the business when Les' idea to give away massive cash in the car park creates a dangerous situation. Also, Ashley embarks on a new in-house business venture.

Seth and Ashley argue over buying a collection of venomous reptiles and hissing roaches, making the staff uncomfortable. Meanwhile, the Golds are unhappy with their security team's performance and decide to look for a new head of security.
David Dickinson and the team have a look at items of interest including a crystal ball and a Rolex watch.
A royal Christmas card lands on Tim Hogarth's table and Sir John Barbirolli's conductor's baton arrives on Corrie Jeffery's desk, while a huge surprise is in store for the owner of a cavalry sword.

Some sellers are in for some real surprises, especially one who thinks her chess set is plastic. A signed Wallis Simpson and Duke of Windsor photograph appears on Ian Towning's table, and will Tim Hogarth be able to buy a bronze pheasant?

David Dickinson is joined by antique dealers Tim Hogarth, Mark Stevens, Cheryl Hakeney and Tony Geering, a seller gives Tim a run for his money, and he loves every minute of it, Mark reveals news to a seller about her diamond earrings and Cheryl gets very excited about a bronze Lorenzl figure.

Today Coalville in Leicestershire plays host to David Dickinson and his team, where Alison Chapman has her work cut out with a seller who's brought in a Clarice Cliff jam pot, Tony Geering tries his best to buy a set of lead toy soldiers and one seller drives a hard bargain for his cavalry sword.

Today Ilford plays host to David Dickinson and his team, where Michael Hogben can't believe his luck when a pair of Doulton figurines arrive at his table, Henry Nicholls tries his best to buy a Breitling watch and seller Mary drives a hard bargain for her collection of silver gilt coins.

David Dickinson travels to Colwyn Bay to help members of the public sort their treasures from their rubbish, where his antiques dealers Karen Dalmeny, David Ford, Helen Gardiner and Corrie Jeffery try their best to buy their favourite items, but it's a Hornby train set that surpasses all expectation today.

Today Matlock in Derbyshire plays host to David Dickinson and his team, where Brenda Haller has her work cut out with a seller who's brought in a silver water jug, Tony Geering tries his best to buy an Asprey's powder compact and one seller drives a hard bargain for her Moroccan watercolour.
A catastrophic breakdown threatens to end the Clermont Diggers' mining season, while the rookie miners' gamble to relocate their old plant ends in disaster.
It's panic stations for the Clermont Diggers when a tourist goes missing. Meanwhile, prospector April is in the line of fire in Ballarat.
Another breakdown triggers all out war between the Clermont Diggers and the Rookie Miners, while a storm causes havoc for Gold Sniper and Rob.
Rookie miner Dennis enjoys a personal-best nugget find in a bumper day, while the Mineshaft Hunters' quest for gold is cut short when a team member takes a life-threatening fall.
The Rookie Miner's search for a mythical gold reef backfires badly, but in Ballarat, prospector Ian and his apprentice April finish their season with a $19,000 gold bonanza.
As the season comes to a close, the Clermont Diggers unearth a monster nugget. Meanwhile, the Mineshaft Hunters face a life-or-death emergency.

Les buys rare rock memorabilia that may be worth a pile of cash. Then, when a man gets caught trying to secretly sell his girlfriend's ring, she dishes out a punishment that's never been seen in the store before.

A couple attempts to return a supposedly mint-condition video game that has since malfunctioned. Meanwhile, a female customer accuses the shop of replacing the stones in her pawned jewellery when speaking to Ashley.
Les ignores Ashley's cries to up security after she finds a potential robber hiding in the shop fridge. It's a move he may regret come nightfall.
Despite the storeroom being packed to the rafters, Les cannot resist buying more. At risk of being labelled a hoarder, he faces mounting pressure to boost sales.
Les gets excited over a jar of powdered gold. An explosive acid test reveals if it is worth thousands, or if it is just eyeshadow.
The shop lands itself in trouble when a customer calls in their lawyer to settle a huge row over a fake receipt. Fortunately, Les has a trick up his sleeve.
Ashley sets up an unusual contest against Seth in the pawn shop. If Seth loses, his closely guarded secret will be revealed to everyone.
Les loses his temper when the kids suggest he sells their failing second store. With the family's livelihood at stake, Seth puts a sneaky plan into action.

After a deadly chemical leak forces Jake to abandon ship, Keith races to locate the Titan Explorer crew and save their ailing vessel. With Sig aboard the Time Bandit, Mandy takes the Northwestern's helm for her first-ever solo king crab season.
Josh dives the waters off Tanzania to find a lost city and its fortunes, search ancient shipwrecks and uncover what could be the walls of a lost city that traded riches.

To solve the mystery of the pyramid's construction, Josh joins a daring experiment to replicate its ancient build. First-of-their-kind 3D scans of a mysterious tunnel system could uncover a labyrinth of secrets buried deep beneath the stone.

At over 9,000 feet, a Colorado family faces inhospitable alpine isolation. Winter looms, threatening to cut them off from civilisation -- and the Raneys must upgrade their infrastructure and water supply before it's too late.
As Arctic ice wreaks havoc on the fishing grounds, Rick risks losing a fortune in crab pots. Johnathan tests the Time Bandit's reinforced bow in a desperate attempt to save the gear.

Coco the Frenchie needs Dr. Jeff's help to remove a large lump from her face; vet tech Christine faces her fear of birds while helping pigeons from Rocky Mountain Adventures; Drs. Jeff and Baier aid a red-back turtle with an infected foot.
Dr. Jeff discovers a large mass on a loveable canine; Dr. Don helps Kelly the vet tech with her dog's sun-damaged nose; Dr. Baier and Hector join forces to treat wild bison.

Dr. Baier suspects a ferret suffers from a spinal injury after being attacked by the family canine. Dr. Jeff travels to a wolf sanctuary to spay and neuter a desperate pack of wolf-hybrids, and three dogs are rescued from an overcrowded shelter.
The trucking industry is often challenging, due in part to the long hours, heavy loads, and busy roads. Truckers from Germany, Italy, and the Netherlands are followed while they work.
Truck drivers from Germany, Italy and Holland share their experiences on the road.
Michel and Dani are on their way to the North Cape with a load of empty fish boxes. Jorn faces a difficult route to Germany. Fabio is on a mission to deliver racing cars on time.

Jörn's satellite navigation system malfunctions and takes him down the completely wrong route. Meanwhile, Alexandra kicks off her long tour heading up to Norway from Neumünster, Germany, and Italian driver Fabio faces the pressure of transporting elite racing cars to France.
The trucker's life is often difficult, partly due to the long days, heavy loads and busy roads. Truckers from Germany, Italy and the Netherlands are followed during their work.
Truckers share their real journeys through long hours, heavy loads, and busy roads.
Tony ambushes Rick with a secret offer. With high hopes, Parker's crew fires up a fourth plant in the Quagmire Cut. Buzz bets on White Channel pay.

Two animal lovers call on Chase Morrill and his team to transform their West Gardiner cabin into a pet sanctuary. The crew works to bring modern-day amenities into a cabin that's over 100 years old, while maintaining its rustic appeal.
An Indiana farming family combines old with new to create a grain bin retreat on their busy working farm.

Dani and Jarrell's heated fight splinters their camp, forcing Jamie to pick sides. A dangerous hunt leads to a shocking food win in another camp. As teams merge, dynamics begin to shift. An agonising stingray attack puts a survivalist at risk.
Bruce heads to Ypres looking for items from WWI, finding a German trench mortar. He also goes for a ride in a WWI-era British tank - one of the first tanks ever used in combat.

In a fictional scenario set in 2029, an asteroid hurtling towards Earth at 40,000 mph will reduce New York to ashes; examining the hypothetical, experts weigh in to determine what could happen, and how it might be stopped.
An accident nearly causes a nuclear catastrophe. Theodore Roosevelt lays down the law in the Wild West. A shocking crime rocks Hollywood.
A rocket-powered wheel takes on the Nazis, an infamous outlaw has a heart of gold and an intrepid climber scales a skyscraper.
Phil and Jess probe the science behind geology's strangest phenomena while investigating mysterious objects flying around Mexico's tallest active volcano.

Josh ventures to Australia's island state of Tasmania to investigate sightings of the supposedly extinct Thylacine, also known as the Tasmanian Tiger. Recent evidence leaves Josh eager to find out the truth about this unusual looking animal.
Henry and Sam check out a quirky collection of custom vehicles in Yorkshire. They end up coming across a vintage monowheel and a plane that has been converted into a three-wheeled car.
In North Yorkshire, Sam and Henry end up examining an incredibly vast collection of classic American motors. However, the guys find themselves most interested in an old rusty Mini.
Henry and Sam look around a shed that is packed full of vintage motorcycles and intriguing memorabilia. The guys see potential in a Yamaha RD350, but have to consider whether they can afford it.
Sam and Henry are in Somerset to check out a magnificent collection of World War Two vehicles. The guys find that the collection includes a Norton 16H as well as a BSA folding bicycle.
After four years of careful restoration, Bruce races to get his Panther tank ready to ship to Australia. And, he discovers an interesting tank manual.
A video game company send Bruce on a mission to find items relating to the Blitz. He sets his eyes on some large pieces and tries to buy a 50-kilogram Luftwaffe bomb and an air raid siren.
Bruce is tasked with finding World War Two spy items that help tell the story of Ian Fleming and James Bond. First, he visits a debonair dealer in London to find some suitable espionage items.

Bike guru Henry Cole and ace mechanic Sam Lovegrove are off to Cornwall. They meet a collector whose cottage is like a transport museum, chock-full with memorabilia, penny farthings and lights of all description.

The boys are off to the West Country and Oxfordshire, in search of vintage treasure to buy, restore and flog. Their discoveries include rare motoring memorabilia, 1970s kitsch and a fabulous collection of stationary engines.

Series in which Henry Cole and Sam Lovegrove nose around people's sheds and garages in search of automotive bargains. Today, in a Cornish surf shack they find a bevy of custom bikes, surf buggies and weird and wonderful objects of all kinds. In Oxfordshire, discoveries include rare motoring memorabilia,1970s kitsch and a fabulous collection of stationary engines. They come, they see, they haggle, they repair and finally sell for a tidy profit.

Series in which Henry Cole and Sam Lovegrove nose around people's sheds and garages in search of automotive bargains. Today, Henry and Sam discover a collection of motorbikes on Bodmin Moor accumulated over 25 years. They snap up a Suzuki B120 but selling it on to Henry's mate means they hardly make any money on it. Later, in Redruth, the pair come across Harry Potter's Ford Anglia. They bid for it and take it home where a buyer is not far away - their sound man Tommy wants it.

The boys are back in town and travelling to Redruth, where they're confronted with Roy's sheds and their ramshackle contents. There's everything from a model canary-yellow Lamborghini to Harry Potter's Anglia!
Henry and Sam explore two sets of sheds in Hampshire, where they find some Japanese bikes and another surprising discovery. Selling their finds proves to be more difficult than expected.
Upholsterer Craig and blacksmith Nev transform a bulky lounge chair into something more artistic. Leather worker Martin rescues an Asprey picnic set.
Drew asks Michael and Maria to revamp a ventriloquist doll that's over 100 years old. Lighting expert Jolene is tasked with reviving a dusty chandelier, and bringing it back its former glory.
Sculptor Nick relives his childhood when he works on a fairground centrepiece. Meanwhile, French polisher Alex transforms a mill trolley, and upholsterer Craig revamps a battered armchair.

The universe's stars are dying off faster than new ones are born. Using the latest technology, experts investigate the secrets of the last stars of the cosmos and what this stellar apocalypse means for life on Earth.
26,000 light-years away at the heart of the galaxy lies a massive black hole. How can something so far away be studied, and what could it teach scientists?

Time travel may be more possible now than ever imagined, and today, cutting-edge technology and the latest research into black holes and wormholes is helping experts get much closer to discovering how to travel through time.

Modern prospectors Alex and Kevin look for business opportunities on old mining claims; they help homesteader Judd and his family reopen a mine and build three weatherproof structures before winter hits.
Builders and mining enthusiasts Alex Charvat and Kevin Gilman transform dormant gold mines into thriving operations and beautiful pieces of real estate.
Experience luxurious supersonic travel on board Concorde's final flight. Narrated by Bill Nighy with appearances by Sir David Frost and Lord Saatchi.
A client wants a German half-track armoured personnel carrier converted into a Pioneer variant, used by the German army during the Battle of the Bulge.
After discovering a 1700s-era cannon, Darrell sets out on a mission to seek the ship's origin. A letter in Gordon's files details a 16th century wreck connected to Sir Francis Drake.
A strange discovery by NASA's Mars Curiosity rover suggests the Red Planet was home to an alien nuclear war 300 million years ago.
Earth is hit by 100 tons of rock from space every day; most burn up in the atmosphere, but a single rock wiped out the dinosaurs.
When a massive star dies it can direct a blast of radiation that would obliterate all life.
Clayton continues his excavation of a rare, carnivorous dinosaur on his Montana ranch. In Wyoming, Mike and Jake prepare to sell their prized T. rex fossil.

Clayton Phipps and his team prepare to flip a 20,000-pound carnivore fossil out of the earth and onto a flatbed to get it to the lab for analysis. Meanwhile, Mike Harris hunts for a duckbill skull and Jared Hudson uncovers an ancient reptile.
Rob examines bizarre markings that suggest a violent clash between prehistoric beasts. In California, he explores a bizarre lake for alien life.
Rob heads to California to investigate a network for major fault lines that could set off a mega-quake. Plus, he explores a mysterious sinkhole.
Storage sheds; industrial fans; parchment paper; climbing walls.
Examines how items such as precast concrete walls, 3D printers, telescopic cranes, and kerosene lamp burners are made.
See how car headlamps, directional drills, and combs are made, and watch stained glass being restored.
Explores the production processes of handcrafted skis, septic tanks, hydro-formed chassis parts, and aquarium windows.
The Chevrolet Corvette Stingray is a fast and lightweight update on an automobile legend from the 1960s. Looking at how the impressive vehicle is constructed.
Heavily inspired by superbike designs, the KTM X-Bow is always road and race ready. Let's look at what elements come together to create this powerful and innovative vehicle.
The Tesla Model S is a high-performance and high-speed vehicle with zero emissions. Looking at what goes into the construction of this innovative electric car.
The Superformance MK III draws inspiration from the Shelby Cobra to be an impressive combination of style and power.
Dark matter is one of the greatest mysteries of the universe facing scientists today. Could it be the cause of supermassive black holes and mass extinctions?
Astronomers have discovered bizarre planets very different to Earth out in the galaxy, but will we ever locate a planet similar to our own?
Dark Matter is thought to be the cosmic glue that holds the universe together, yet the search for it continues to eluded scientists today.

Determining the age of the universe continues to be an elusive endeavour for scientists as their results are conflicting, and without a definitive answer, everything that's known about the cosmos could be completely wrong.
More everyday items go under the microscope, revealing their production. How are objects such as gummy vitamins and boat trailers made?
More everyday items go under the microscope, revealing their production. How are objects such as water well cylinders and nonconductive tools made?
More everyday items go under the microscope, revealing their production. How are objects such as stand-up paddleboards and vacuum cleaners made?
More everyday items go under the microscope, revealing their production. How are objects such as detectable warning panels and model Stirling engines made?
A recent creature sighting outside the infamous Skinwalker Ranch brings Chuck and the team to Utah to investigate. Evidence indicates it might be an alien.
An ongoing series of UFO sightings off the Southern California coastline leads Chuck and the team to examine the link between UFOs, the military and the ocean.

Most waterways of Alaska are still unexplored, and local folklore tells of hidden channels and monstrous beasts lurking in the depths. One of the most terrifying of all those beasts is said to live in Lake Iliamna.
A woman claims to be under attack from an unseen force. Could it be linked to a Native American legend about a mysterious race of giants?
After successfully locating a shipwreck tied to Christopher Columbus using Cooper's intel, now Miklos has eight weeks of cash left to find another shipwreck as he sets out on another expedition.
Chris and Francis try to make up lost time following lengthy wheel problems, but leaky brakes and a 12-tonne jigsaw stand in their way.
When Andy's dad, Bobby, decides to fix up the ultimate junker, he has his doubts. But Bobby's ready to prove Andy wrong with some old tricks.

A new customer challenges Bill with his fully customised '37 Ford Coupe, which he wants to be restored to its factory look; as one of their biggest builds yet, the '53 tanker proves again and again that the bigger the truck, the bigger the build.

The 1999 BMW Z3 M Coupe is one of the best-driving cars on the road, and Mike's found an excellent example to bring back to the workshop. Ant will have to strengthen the subframe, delete the fan and repair the seats, while Mike takes care of the wheels.
A passion project by a few mechanics ended up creating a new kind of car, the hot hatch. A panel of motoring experts discuss the five best hot hatches of all time.
A panel of motoring experts discuss the five best supercars. These are the high-tech cars that push the boundaries of what is possible in performance and design.
A panel of motoring experts discuss the five greatest sports cars ever made. These cars are the speedy game-changers whose iconic designs have endured the test of time.
On a trip to Worcestershire, Henry and Sam find themselves falling in love with a barn full of vintage automobilia. However, the guys find it hard work to negotiate with the vendors.
A crane disastrously falls across two lanes of traffic during construction work on a landmark bridge in New York City.

Disaster strikes a new railway bridge as a crane collapses in the middle of major construction in Italy; experts investigate and uncover a compromise in balance with improperly positioned counterweights and a manoeuvre that resulted in catastrophe.

Tragedy strikes a community when a condominium complex collapses in Miami, resulting in one of the deadliest engineering disasters in American history; experts investigate and reveal potential flaws in the structure's flat slab construction.

An unprecedented cycle of freezing and thawing causes dramatic destruction to a landmark bridge in Pennsylvania; experts investigate and reveal how a sudden surge of icy flood water buckled pier foundations weakened from years of erosion.
The Rocky Mountain National Park is famed for its landscapes and mountains. Lawn Lake Dam enlarged a natural lake into a reservoir at an almost 3000m elevation.
Paul persuades Drew to buy a Triumph TR4, and he pays homage to one of his automotive heroes. The boys reinstate a favourite stylish feature that unfortunately never made it to production.
Drew and Paul rescue a classic: a Vauxhall Viva. The car was extensively modified in the 1960s but after years in storage, it's well past its best.
Paul has paid just over £15,000 for an Alfa Romeo 2000 GTV that appears to be in great shape. However, Drew is horrified when he learns it's an automatic.

Henry and Sam are in Henry's home county of Oxfordshire in search of new bargains. They meet three brothers with containers full of bikes, plus many tractors, trucks and other trinkets. Sam is keen on getting a motorbike and Henry agrees, but Henry also has his eye on something else...
Henry and Sam are back in Devon in search of new bargains. They meet Rodney at his workshop, full of signs, petrol pumps, vintage British cars and lots of rust!

Henry and Sam are in Worcestershire, meeting farmer Adrian. They find a shed full of bikes that aren't really Sam's cup of tea. However, Sam's mood changes when they come across a four-wheeled delight out in a field.

Henry and Sam are in North Yorkshire with Paul, a lover of Triumph motorcycles. Unfortunately, it seems that many of the bikes are out of their price range, until they find something lurking in the dark corner of the shed.
Richard investigates the gigantic Volkswagen car factory, as he explores how it works and checks out the futuristic technology used by the mega-factory in Wolfsburg, Germany.

Richard Hammond climbs aboard the US Air Force's biggest cargo plane, an airborne behemoth that uses cutting-edge engineering, and the latest technology to fly vital equipment and heavy-duty military vehicles across the planet.

Jim Foody transports critical medical supplies through flood-ravaged roads, Jake Pakai hauls multimillion-dollar equipment across narrow highways, and Robbie Mackay faces a tight curfew in a high-stakes double house move.

Die Halloweenparty von Luke droht ein Desaster zu werden, doch der Rest der Familie bemerkt das gerade noch rechtzeitig. Jay zwingt Manny dazu, ihn bei einem gemeinen und hinterhältigen Streich gegen seinen Erzfeind zu unterstützen.

Neueste Produkte werden im Fernsehen für ein bequemes Einkaufserlebnis präsentiert. Von praktischen Haushaltshelfern und weichen Badetüchern bis hin zu vielseitigen Sportgeräten bietet das abwechslungsreiche Sortiment zahlreiche Angebote.

Die Sendung bringt mit vielen neuen Ideen frischen Wind auf die Bildschirme. Schneiden, Kleben, Ausmalen und Mitgestalten - sie zeigt großen und kleinen Zuschauern, wie man aus den unscheinbarsten Dingen die tollsten Sachen zaubert.

Darly, Loomis und ihre Freunde erleben epische Abenteuer auf einer magischen Insel. Gemeinsam entdecken sie eine bunte Welt voller Fantasie und meistern jede Herausforderung mit echtem Teamgeist. Sei gespannt auf die tollen Eindrücke!

Mickey und seine Freunde feiern Halloween auf der Zauberinsel, wo die Hexe Clarabelle sie zu einer Halloween-Schnitzeljagd einlädt. Die Gruppe begibt sich auf den Weg, da am Ende des Abenteuers eine Überraschung auf alle Beteiligten wartet.
Ginny, Sparks, Buddy und Bitsy sind Superkätzchen, die ihre Kräfte einsetzen, um den Tag zu retten.
In Sofias Schloss findet eine Übernachtungsparty statt. Zane hilft einem Drachen.

Amadeus verkleidet sich als Roboter. Doch das Kostüm entwickelt ein Eigenleben und macht Jagd auf Süßigkeiten. Darüber hinaus stiehlt der Bösewicht Swarm alle Kürbisse der Stadt. Um Halloween zu retten, muss das Team die Kürbisse zurückholen.
Animated, Adventure, Action, Comedy, Science fiction, Children

Nach dem Tode des Königs von England ist die Erbfolge unklar. Als ein Schwert aus dem Himmel fällt und in einem Stein steckenbleibt, versucht der kleine Waisenjunge Floh sein Glück. Denn wer es vermag, das Schwert herauszuziehen, ist rechtmäßiger Thronfolger. Floh wird vom mächtigen Zauberer Merlin entdeckt und findet Gefallen an seinen Zaubertricks. Doch dann trifft Floh auf eine gefährliche Hexe und muss eine schwierige Entscheidung treffen.

Micky will seinen und Donald Ducks Neffen zu Halloween eine Gruselgeschichte erzählen, die ihnen die Haare zu Berge stehen lässt. Aber das ist gar nicht so leicht, wenn man es mit Jungs zu tun hat, die mit allen Wassern gewaschen sind.

Woody und seine Freunde befinden sich in einem Motel, als nach und nach Spielzeuge verschwinden. Die Freunde müssen versuchen, das Geheimnis des Verschwindens zu lüften, bevor alle von ihnen weg sind.

Isabella hat schrecklichen Schluckauf. Da man Schluckauf am schnellsten durch Erschrecken loswird, beschließen Phineas und Ferb, ein furchterregendes Geisterschloss zu bauen. Allerdings schlagen alle Schreckensmaßnahmen fehl. Erst als Phineas aus dem Turm des Schlosses stürzt, scheint Isabella sich richtig zu erschrecken.
Die Kinder begegnen an Halloween einem Jungen namens Russell. In seinem Haus spukt es.
Animated, Children, Holiday, Adventure, Action, Comedy

Drei kurze Geschichten werden aus einem mysteriösen Buch erzählt, die "Schockierende Tri-State Trilogie des Terrors". Entchen Momo erwacht zum Leben, Dr. Doofenshmirtz hat drei Wünsche frei vom großen, schwebenden Babykopf und bösartige Klone von Perry richten verheerende Schäden an.
Scratch lädt echte Geister in ein Halloween-Spukhaus ein, aber die Dinge geraten außer Kontrolle.

Es ist Halloween in Gravity Falls mit Kürbislaternen und jeder Menge Süßigkeiten. Als Mabel und Dipper losziehen wollen, um "Süßes oder Saures" zu spielen, bemerkt Wendy, dass das nur was für Kinder sei. Das führt dazu, dass Dipper ein Süßigkeiten-Monster beleidigt, welches daraufhin Mabel und Dipper dazu zwingt, für ihn Süßigkeiten zu sammeln, oder es frisst sie auf.
Die Pines-Familie beschließt, eine Karaoke-Party in der "Mystery Shack" zu feiern.
Um einem wortkargen Besucher etwas zu verkaufen, erfindet Gronkel Stan abenteuerliche Geschichten.
Tick und Nicky erkunden einen verlassenen U-Bahn-Tunnel, um zu beweisen, dass es Monster gibt.
Tick und Trick werden von ihrem Cousin auf eine Expedition in ein Unterwasser-Labor mitgenommen.
Die Kinder beschließen, zu Halloween in das gruseligste Haus in Entenhausen zu gehen.

Von einer Wahrsagerin erhält Cricket eine unangenehme Prophezeiung. Nun setzt er alles daran, dies zu verhindern. Später ist Cricket in einem Escape-Room gefangen. Dort muss er sich zwischen seiner Familie und der Freiheit entscheiden.

Leider fallen Bills Kürbisse dieses Jahr sehr mickrig aus und er ist enttäuscht. Nach einem Besuch bei Gwendolyn Zapp nimmt Tilly heimlich eine außerirdische Substanz mit, die die Kürbisse größer und schöner machen soll, um ihm eine Freude zu machen.

Cricket und seine Familie ziehen vom Land in die Großstadt, was zuerst einen großen Kulturschock auslöst. Doch Cricket ist optimistisch und naiv, was ihn schnell neue Freunde finden lässt. Zusammen erleben sie viele Abenteuer in der großen Stadt.
An seinem ersten Halloween in Big City erhofft Cricket sich eine größere Süßigkeitenausbeute.

Während Marinette und ihre Mitschüler eines Samstags an der Schule einen Film drehen wollen, müssen sie feststellen, dass die Hauptdarstellerin Mylene an Lampenfieber leidet. Mylene ist aufgebracht und Hawk Moth nutzt ihre emotionale Lage aus.

Die Elfenbrüder Ian und Barley Lightfoot leben in einer magischen, von Fabelwesen bewohnten Welt. Doch die Technisierung schreitet in ihrer Heimat immer weiter fort und die Magie geht immer mehr verloren. Die Teenager nutzen ihre verbleibenden Zauberkräfte, um einen letzten magischen Tag mit ihrem Vater zu verbringen, der starb, als sie noch klein waren. Gemeinsam begibt sich die Familie auf eine spannende Reise.
Movie, Animated, Children, Comedy, Fantasy, Adventure

Ein unerfahrenes Alien soll mit dem Raumschiff einen Menschen aus seinem Haus entführen. Das Alien ist jedoch so nervös, dass es die verschiedenen Knöpfe der Raumschiff-Armatur nicht mehr richtig zuordnen kann und dem Menschen so Schaden zufügt.

Der kleine Miguel hat einen großen Traum. Er will ein erfolgreicher Musiker werden, genauso wie einst sein Großvater Ernesto de la Cruz. Doch der hat damals seine Frau verlassen, also hat die Musik in seiner Familie nicht gerade einen hohen Stellenwert. Eines Tages findet Miguel die Gitarre seines Großvaters in einer Kapelle. Als er sie zu spielen beginnt, öffnet sich ihm ein Tor zur Unterwelt und zur Musik.
Movie, Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Music

Bei einem Ritual in der Halloween-Nacht erwecken die Teenager Becca und Izzy in Salem versehentlich die drei Sanderson-Schwestern wieder zum Leben, nachdem sie 29 Jahre zuvor bereits einmal von ihrem Fluch befreit wurden.

Phil und Claire wollen Halloween wieder groß feiern, aber diesmal scheint niemand ihre Begeisterung zu teilen. Die Kinder haben ihre eigenen Pläne. Mitch und Cam sind fassungslos, wie lange Jay für die Renovierung ihrer Küche benötigt.
Um Minnie und den anderen Hausbewohnern zu helfen, stellt sich Micky einem wütenden Wasserboiler.
Neun ehemalige Teilnehmer der Sendung sind zurück und werden im Dschungel von Ecuador ausgesetzt.

Neun unerschrockene Kandidaten wagen das Abenteuer in Ecuador. Dort wimmelt es vor Kaimanen, Giftspinnen und Anakondas. Zudem überschwemmen heftige Unwetter regelmäßig das Amazonasbecken. Durchhaltevermögen ist bei den Abenteurern gefragt.

Die sechs verbliebenen Kandidaten beschließen, von nun an als Team zusammenzuarbeiten. Sie helfen sich sogar gegenseitig mit Nahrungsvorräten aus. Doch plötzlich müssen sie um ihren Anführer Matt bangen. Dieser hat sich schwer verletzt.

Das Team ist niedergeschlagen, als sie erfahren, dass ausgerechnet Matt ausscheidet. Dieser hatte mit seinen Jagdkünsten die anderen Kandidaten regelmäßig mit Nahrung versorgt. Doch mit der Infektion an Matts Füßen ist nicht zu spaßen.

Die Vollprofis lassen ein fertiges Meisterwerk zu Wasser. Dabei ist eine ruhige Hand gefragt. Denn es stehen Hunderttausende Euro auf dem Spiel. Einen kühlen Kopf braucht auch das Team in Rostock, das sich auf kultige VW-Bullis und Transporter spezialisiert hat. Und die Experten kennen sich bestens mit Offroad- und Expeditionsfahrzeugen aus. Die Truppe kümmert sich um das Vehikel eines Survival-Influencers.

Aus der Werkstatt von BS Camperwerk in Bad Bramstedt rollen maßgeschneiderte Wohnmobile und Campervans. Beim Ausbau von zwei Prototypen schaut der Auftraggeber über die Schulter der Vollprofis, die sowieso schon unter Zeitdruck stehen.

Die Beamten der Guardia Civil durchsuchen das Gepäck eines Passagierflugzeugs aus Kiew. Zigarettenschmuggel aus Osteuropa ist nicht unüblich. Tatsächlich entdecken sie bei dieser Stichprobe eine große Menge unverzollter Tabakwaren.

Düsenjets gelten als echte Kraftpakete und sind deshalb schwer zu fliegen. Auch im Modellbau gehört ihre Fertigung zur Königsdisziplin. Marcus und sein Kontrahent Matthias müssen bei ihren Nachbauten auf besonders viele Details achten.
Diese Sendung wirbt für verschiedene Produkte, die man sich bequem nach Hause schicken lassen kann.

Marcus Thiel und sein Team verfolgen in Neerstedt ein klares Ziel: Die Mechanik-Profis wollen einen betagten Radlader in einen echten Blickfang verwandeln. Philipp aus dem Hanfbachtal startet mit seinem Faun im französischen Fublaines.

Uli und seine Arbeitskollegen haben am 100 000 Quadratmeter großen Container-Terminal in Wörth am Rhein alle Hände voll zu tun. Die Vollprofis sollen 43 fabrikneue Lkws auf ein Schiff laden. Die Fahrzeuge kommen aus dem Werk nebenan.

Zwei Ferraris und ein Maybach sollen pünktlich nach Dubai abheben, denn die neuen Eigentümer warten schon auf ihre Autos. Steven und Patrick machen deswegen die noblen Schlitten am Flughafen Leipzig/Halle versandfertig.

Möbel, Baumaterialien, Lebensmittel und Pakete, Kapitän Gero und sein Azubi Marvin beliefern mit dem Versorgungsfrachter Frisia VII die Bewohner der Nordseeinsel Juist. In Plochingen am Neckar wird tonnenweise Stahlschrott recycelt.

Das wird kein Spaziergang! Franks Hühnerstall in Michigan ist vollgepackt bis unter das Dach. Um an die kostbaren Schätze zu gelangen, die sich angeblich darin verbergen, müssen Matt Paxton und sein Team den großen Schuppen vollständig leerräumen.

Penney sammelt seit seiner Kindheit Mineralien und Fossilien. Da wird Matt Paxton hellhörig, denn seltene Exemplare erzielen auf dem Markt hohe Preise. In Maryland könnten sich auch afrikanische Holzmasken und Skulpturen als Volltreffer erweisen.

Drew Pritchard begutachtet eine Kunst- und Raritätensammlung, die komplett zum Verkauf steht. Das Problem ist, dass die Objekte von einem Testamentsvollstrecker verwaltet werden und ihr wahrer Wert für Drew schwierig zu taxieren ist.

Der Raritäten-Jäger Drew Pritchard sieht sich in einer ehemaligen Textilfabrik nach antiken Möbeln um. Der neue Besitzer des Gebäudes möchte alles loswerden, um neu durchzustarten. Ein Medizinwagen und Aktenschränke haben es Drew besonders angetan.
Hat ein Mitarbeiter im Frachtbereich des Flughafens Gepäckstücke geöffnet und Passagiere bestohlen? Eine Sondereinheit der Guardia Civil führt in Madrid eine gezielte Operation durch.

Beamte der Guardia Civil haben im Hafen von Algeciras unter den Vordersitzen eines Fahrzeugs aus Ceuta ein kaum sichtbares Detail entdeckt. Unter der Metallplatte könnte sich ein Hohlraum verbergen, der als Versteck für Schmuggelware dient.

Ein italienischer Staatsbürger versucht am Flughafen Orio al Serio fünf Kilometer südöstlich von Bergamo der Gepäckkontrolle zu entgehen. Damit zieht er die Aufmerksamkeit der Guardia di Finanza auf sich und muss durchsucht werden.

Am Flughafen von Venedig versucht ein Passagier, das Sicherheitspersonal mit seinem Status als Unternehmer zu beeindrucken. Aber das lässt die Grenzschützer kalt. Die Koffer des Mannes werden trotz seiner Ablenkungsmanöver gründlich untersucht.

Der Rettungsdienst hat in Berlin einen Betrunkenen auf einem Supermarktparkplatz aufgelesen. Der Mann spricht nur Russisch und sein Zustand verschlechtert sich zusehends. Im Bundeswehrkrankenhaus droht ein multiples Organversagen.
Der Weihnachtsmarkt in Rostock zählt zu den größten seiner Art in Norddeutschland. Einige Besucher haben dort reichlich Alkohol konsumiert.

Ein Ladenbesitzer wurde in Nottingham laut eigener Aussage von drei bewaffneten Jugendlichen mit einer Pistole bedroht. Die Polizisten machen in der Umgebung eine Gruppe von Teenagern ausfindig, die zwischen 13 und 15 Jahre alt sind.

Eine Spezialeinheit der Polizei von Nottingham observiert zwei Drogenkonsumenten vor einem Einkaufszentrum. Die Einsatzkräfte bringen sich in Position, um den vermeintlichen Dealer der beiden Männer hinter Schloss und Riegel zu bringen.

Ein Team von Weltklasse-Show-Wrestlern bietet den Fans zum ersten Mal seit 20 Jahren ein neues Wrestling-Erlebnis. Mit von der Partie sind Cody und Brandi Rhodes, Kenny Omega, Henker Adam Page, Chris Jericho und Jon Moxley.
In Mexico's unforgiving, cenote-covered landscape, two survivalists face venomous coral snakes, territorial jaguars, blood-sucking sand-flies and a duck named Henry.

Two survivalists brave a vast cave system in the Colombian rainforest. Trying to survive 21 days, the jungle tests them with threats including venomous fer-de-lance snakes, piranhas, and biting insects.

The team travels to Clifton Forge, Virginia, to conquer C&O Railway's steam engine repair plant. Using force and a lot of tools, they work to save unique pieces like railway bases and corrugated glass.

Robert sends Tay and Grayson to salvage on their own in Salem, Virginia, while Mike and Ted travel to Norfolk, Virginia, to pick up a special nautical structure for a client. The Dawgs come together in the end to finish the salvage.
An upcoming drop in the price of king crab has the skippers rushing to finish their season, but crew battles and a fierce storm block the way.
The king crab season goes down to the wire as our struggling skippers battle to top off their quotas. Who will land a bumper haul in this end of season sprint?
It's the start of the 2009 Crab Season, and things are looking up for our spectacular skipper, but will their dreams be shattered by a colossal rogue wave?
The Wizard must change course when three deckhands are badly hurt, and it's decision time as the ice closes in - will Phil gamble on the weather or cut and run?

After sinking a new shaft to save their backs, The Bushmen are stonewalled by impenetrable rock. The Mooka Boys are finally ready to start tunnelling toward black opal glory, until their last working machine suffers a catastrophic breakdown.
When Mark is hospitalised after a mining accident, Paul and John must work overtime on two separate claims to scrape together enough opal to survive the week.

Verschiedene Episoden bieten pikante Einsichten in das Liebesleben junger Mädchen: Die Redakteure einer Schülerzeitung erhalten Leserbriefe, in denen Schülerinnen ungehemmt ihre sexuellen Erlebnisse beschreiben. Ein Klassenausflug endet als Liebesfahrt, nachdem die Schüler heimlich ein leidenschaftliches Paar beobachtet haben. In dieser Sendung wird das große und brandneue "Bianca Wunschkonzert" übertragen.

Der ehemalige Kapitän Jonny Jensen betreibt seit Jahren die traditionsreiche Hamburger Seemannskneipe "Herz von St. Pauli". Doch nun, da er die Kneipe seinem Sohn Hein vermachen will, steht sie kurz vor dem Ruin. Jonny sieht keinen anderen Ausweg, als zwielichtige Gestalten zu seinen Geschäftspartnern zu machen. Doch die wollen den alten Seebären ohne sein Wissen in krumme Geschäfte verwickeln. Als die Polizei dahinterkommt, macht Jonny sich auf die Suche nach den wahren Tätern.
Die Sendung geht auf Zeitreise mit den schönsten und bekanntesten Hits von Roy Black.

Das junge Liebespaar Helmut und Ingrid wünscht sich eine eigene Wohnung. Doch dazu müssen sie den Bund der Ehe eingehen. Nach ihrer Hochzeit finden sie eine Wohnung und versuchen, auf eigenen Beinen zu stehen. Doch die leidigen Verwandten sind dabei nicht hilfreich, die mit ihren gut gemeinten Ratschlägen ständig vorbeikommen.

Operettendiva Charlotte ist fest entschlossen, ihren Verehrer, den bankrotten Grafen Rosen-Bückburg, vor dem sozialen Abstieg zu bewahren. Deshalb gibt sie sich als Großherzogin Christine aus und macht sich für den verarmten Adligen stark. Damit hilft sie ihm nicht nur in Finanz-, sondern auch in Liebesdingen. Der Schwindel droht allerdings aufzufliegen, als plötzlich die echte Großherzogin Christine auftaucht.

Zwei amerikanische Gangster setzen sich auf der Flucht vor dem FBI nach Hamburg ab und gehen im Amüsierviertel St. Pauli ihren Geschäften nach. Als es dort zu heiß wird, versuchen sie es in München im Stadtteil Schwabing und werden dort schließlich verhaftet. In dieser Zeit erleben sie zahllose schnelle Abenteuer mit sexwilligen Mädchen, Frauen und auch Lesbierinnen. Ihre beiden in New York zurück gebliebenen Kumpane haben fast das gleiche Vergnügen, bis die Polizei zuschnappt.
Nicola's been divorced twice but is still young at heart and hopes for a new love. Mark, who has Crohn's disease, has lost his body confidence but is now ready to conquer his fear.

Stubborn Scottish dictatorial chef and owner Andy has cooked for celebrated chefs in the past, but since opening Le Bistro has lost his passion for cooking and doesn't listen to anyone. With customers grading his food 3/10, and Andy not responding well to criticism, can Gordon get him to listen?

Gordon tries to rescue the failing business but is shocked to discover CeCe has lost her way in the kitchen.

The deep is perhaps the most hostile environment on earth, a world of crushing pressure, brutal cold and utter darkness. Exploration has barely begun, and yet it is the largest living space on the planet. Scientists already think that there is more life in the deep than anywhere else on earth.

Coral reefs are home to one-quarter of all marine species and survival in these undersea megacities is a challenge with many different solutions; a turtle heads to the reef's equivalent of a health spa, but she must use trickery to avoid the queue.

The big blue is the world's greatest wilderness, far from shore and many kilometres deep. It's a vast marine desert where there is little to eat and nowhere to hide. Yet it's home to some of the biggest and most spectacular creatures on earth.

It is the green of the sea that brings life to oceans. Here, sunlight powers the growth of kelp, mangroves and seagrass. The green seas teem with life, where cuttlefish do battle for a mate and an octopus outwits deadly sharks.

En contrepoint à ces tragédies quotidiennes s'enchaînent aussi des événements personnels pour des flics sous tension, entre fous rires et coups de gueule. Fred et Melissa tombent amoureux ; Nadine divorce et puis regrette ; l'anorexie et la solitude d'Iris s'aggravent.
