Claire, who's 22, is rushed to Queen's Medical Centre after collapsing while she was running. Emma has significant burns to her leg after spilling a kettle of boiling water. And 50-year-old Adele is struggling to walk after injuring her toe.
Some strong pain relief results in unexpected hilarity following a serious footballing injury. Meanwhile, Rose is freed from a rolled car.
A ten-week-old baby is rushed in after choking on his milk at home. Fifty-something Tony has a flesh-eating leg infection. And is the bruising on Gerald's leg more serious than he realises?

The camping critics make their way to Tyn-yr-Onnen, a working farm on the edge of Snowdonia National Park. Campsite hosts Len and Helen encourage their guests to embrace farm life, from feeding alpacas and herding sheep, to picking exotic mushrooms.

The first to host is Mrs Tee of Gorse Meadow, a four star B&B in the New Forest. Her eccentric personality charms the guests on arrival but not everyone's room is up to scratch. John and Neil's bathroom window needs fixing and Alistair and Emma Mundell find they are sharing their room with ladybirds, cobwebs and dust.

It's Alistair and Emma Mundell's turn to host in sleepy Lynton, North Devon. Their four-star Castle Hill Guesthouse only opened three months ago, and the B&B newbies are desperate to impress with their recently renovated rooms. The accommodation proves a winner with Mark and Fee and John and Neil, but Mrs Tee is proving more difficult to please.

The competition heads north to Blackpool and the three-star Vidella, run by fun-loving best friends and business partners John and Neil. To pay back Alistair for being a self-confessed Blackpool-hater the Vidella boys have rigged his room with practical jokes. The fun continues at activity time as Neil appears in drag and leads the group to Funny Girls drag cabaret bar.

For the final visit the group checks into the boutique B&B Urban Beach in Bournemouth - run by local entrepreneur Mark Crib. With top prices of £170, the chic rooms come with all mod cons and super deluxe bathrooms. The afternoon's activity is a speedboat ride along the Jurassic coast. All the guests approve - even Mrs Tee is full of praise.

The hosts come face to face one last time to find out what they have been paid and to thrash out their differences. There's soon trouble as Mrs Tee finds out that it's Alistair and Emma who scored her one lowly point for cleanliness. The confrontation continues when the roles are reversed with a heated exchange resulting in a walk out.

Jasmine Harman helps Caroline and Gary fulfil their dream of owning a house in Spain for regular getaways to the countryside and villages of Valencia province. Jasmine shows them five fantastic options for their budget of £150,000.

Lee Juggurnauth heads to southeast Spain around the Costa Cálida to help Trevor and Mel from Birmingham find their dream holiday home. They're looking for a two-bedroom flat for their budget of £67,000.

Cumbria couple Samantha and Sam want to find their dream holiday home in Spain that works for them and their teenage sons. They place all their trust in Lee Juggurnauth to find the perfect home at the right place for them.

Rachel and Robin dream of buying a holiday home in Alicante's Jalón Valley, with the hope of relocating there in the future. For their budget of £250,000, Ben Hillman shows them five great properties.

The week's competition comes from the West Midlands, where the first host, entrepreneur and social media star Kuda, takes his guests on a culinary adventure, with a Zimbabwean and world-influenced African à la carte menu.

Construction recruitment consultant Rich, hopes to impress his guests with his Italian-themed night and food 'like mama used to make'. He hopes his guests will be eating out of the palm of his hand to seal him the £1000 prize.

Pharmacy technician Amy serves up an Asian extravaganza, on a night featuring a missing guest, some dodgy dancing and banter. As the evening draws to a close, a rude remark leaves one guest open-mouthed.

Make-up artist and self-professed 'glam goth' Sophie hosts, and her guests are shocked when she reveals a guilty pleasure. Things get even more awkward when our host finds herself on the receiving end of very frank feedback about her food.
On the final night, club owner Phil treats his guests to a glitzy 'awards show' night. Phil's confident that his soupy starter, porky main course and trifling dessert will seal the deal.

The competition starts in Harrogate where management team Chris 'Clarky' Clarke and Katie Light help run the White Hart Hotel. The guests meet some llamas and the extra charge for fancy coffee causes a stir.
The second visit is to New Promenade Hotel in Blackpool, owned by Raouf, who is joined by friend Chrissie. There's a teetering toilet seat and Clarky and Katie find muck on the taps.
The third visit is to Vicky's small terraced house, aptly named The Terrace, in Oxford. On inspection, two pairs of guests discover an array of filthy finds, including a pre-sucked sweet.
The final visit is to Robin and Liza's Georgian mansion Tall John's House in the Brecon Beacons. At dinner the guests gush over their new friendships, but Vicky doesn't share their feelings.

It's the final day of the competition and the B&B owners are meeting for the last time to settle some scores. The White Hart Hotel is up first and management team Clarky and Katie want to park the issue of paying for their car park.

Following Sister Jen's night shift, which kick-starts as a 35-year-old stabbing victim, Colin Richards, is rushed in by ambulance with injuries to his lung, arm and liver. He's accompanied by his 19-year-old girlfriend, Esther, who was lying in bed next to him when they were awoken at gunpoint. While Esther cradles her boyfriend in Resus, Jen tends to Nancy Shirley, 86, who has spent her life alone and fell over at home.

John, 77, has been sent to A&E with his wife Brenda after a routine health screening revealed a potentially deadly 'Triple A' - abdominal aortic aneurysm - a dramatic swelling of the main artery that could burst at any moment, making him a 'walking time bomb'. The only option is major surgery. Meanwhile, 92-year-old widow Eileen has been brought into hospital after falling and spending the night on the floor.
Doctors Scott Taylor and Jonathan Papson help a pregnant woman who's been badly injured in a high-speed traffic crash.
The charitable Ella heads out on a boat in 1905 and ends up in 2025. Nick has to figure out how to get her back in time and decide if their newfound love can stand the test of it.
After a snowstorm prevents all the presents from being delivered to base, two rival marines must team up for a special mission to save Christmas.
A New York City book editor takes on a temporary gig running a Maine bookshop for the month of December. While battling with the owners' son, she rediscovers her passion for nurturing creativity.

In three intertwined timelines, different generations of one family navigate holiday challenges, from caring for an ageing father to planning a Christmas Eve wedding, while rediscovering love and family connections.
A loving couple shares the story of how they met and fell in love when their daughter's boyfriend comes to meet them for the first time at Christmas.
Interior designer, Rose DeMonte, uses her skills back in her hometown to renovate a Christmas Charity Home for her brother Sal and his contractor Brysen's home flipping company.
A local champion skier and Vermont brew master team up with an unlikely match to create a seasonal microbrew to save her family's business before Christmas.

Ella, an ambitious marketing executive in New York, is sent on assignment to a remote ranch in Canada. When she meets Cole, the handsome, country-loving rancher, her ambitions change as she unexpectedly finds herself falling in love.

A serious TV newscaster's life changes when he meets his young superfan and the boy's hardworking single mum. As he embraces positive holiday stories, romance blooms - but a career opportunity forces him to choose between ambition and love.
The house is stunned to discover that Marnie left after Aaron and Chelsea got together. Elettra and Marty boot off over their hot tub frisk and Chloe pushes Marty to a breaking point.
When Duchess returns to town, post heart surgery, she and Caesar face each other for the first time since their break-up. Puma throws a grand opening party for his new shop, Ink 124.
Dutchess makes a surprise appearance at Walt's baby shower where she tries to make amends with Puma. While Dutch is working late, Ceaser makes an unexpected decision.
Jon Taffer heads to St. Augustine, Florida to help a military vet rescue his struggling bar amidst poor sales and an unruly staff.
Tensions arise between Jenna and Matty when Collin invites her to a swanky photography showcase at his house. Julie hosts the annual Black Friday party and Ming becomes head of the Asian mafia.
Daria creates fictional versions of her family and friends for an assignment.
Briana and Javi make major choices about their relationship and Javi turns to Kailyn. Ali's health issues become more obvious, worrying Leah. Chelsea surprises Cole with the baby's gender.
Melissa Rycroft comes to the first rehearsal to look for showmanship mentoring candidates; then Brittany Perry-Russell shakes up the candidates with her choreography.
The candidates are taught techniques to get their kicks even higher; Evan Miller teaches his fast-paced choreography that has Kelli concerned for one of the candidates.

Denise DiCharry teaches high level choreography to see who learns quickly. Kelli gets to know the rookie candidates better during uniform fittings. And will an inappropriate post on social media lead to one of the ladies being cut?
It was love at first sight when Justin met Basma a year ago. Justin wants Basma and her son to come with him, but first he needs to find out what Basma is hiding from him.

Farrah is dating to marry and believes that Neon is the one, but he won't introduce her to his family. Together for six months, Farrah wants to know why she's being hidden before committing more of her heart, soul or body.

James and Verletta have been dating for over a year. They live together, and his family loves her. They're talking about marriage and children, but James still hasn't met a single person in Verletta's life.
Leo turns the sisters into Greek goddesses so they will be able to vanquish mythic giants; Piper's life is turned upside down when Leo accepts the call to become leader of the Elders.

Phoebe and Paige's search for Leo leads them to the mythical island of Valhalla. Meanwhile, Phoebe discovers she is an empath, and begins to come to terms with the repercussions of her dangerous new power.
Phoebe, Paige, Leo and Darryl have escaped from Valhalla, but Piper has decided to stay behind and live as a Valkyrie. Leo is deeply suspicious of Chris.
The Cleaners erase Wyatt's existence, after he accidentally brings a dragon to life. Meanwhile, Paige is caught in the middle of sexual harassment troubles.
Three evil sisters steal the Charmed Ones' identities and powers, Paige realises magic will always be a part of her life, and Leo tries to find out who put him on the Island of Valhalla.
Leanna falls so hard for Jordan that she sends him thousands of dollars. Though she's never met Jordan in person she does meet his cousin. Nev and Kamie go on a manhunt searching for the cousin.

Montreal beauty Apryl fell for Ohio artist Daryl after years of him courting her by drawing portraits of Apryl. Wanting love, but suspecting the art of deception, Nev and Kamie fear this case is going from sketches to sketchy!

William fell hard for Carmella but after spending hours on the phone, sharing the most intimate details together, Carmella won't meet up or even video chat. Nev and Kamie help William figure out what secrets Carmella is hiding.
Dr Natalia Spierings tackles one of the biggest lipomas of her career, Dr Emma McMullen helps a bride who's six weeks away from 'I do', Dr Adil Sheraz treats a patient with a face cyst.

An adaptation of the novel by Stieg Larsson. Mikael Blomkvist is a disgraced journalist who is offered the chance to write a family biography for Henry Vanger, a wealthy industrialist, and to secretly find out what happened to Harriet Vanger who went missing 40 years ago. He is joined by Lisbeth Salander, who is a computer hacker.
The discovery of Tutankhamun's largely intact tomb in 1922 by a team of excavators led by archaeologist Howard Carter was arguably more significant than his short reign as a pharaoh.
Satellite images reveal a series of large mounds in Romania, just a few miles from the home of Vlad the Impaler. Could these mounds be Dracula's long-lost grave?
A strange structure might point the way to a lost civilisation's fountain of youth. Also, bizarre marks across the eastern US leave experts baffled.

John Lennon and May Pang claimed to have seen a UFO from their balcony in New York, and a sinister visitor to a remote nuclear missile launch site in Montana, which more than 40 years ago caused nuclear missiles to be disabled for 24 hours.
Could history's most powerful men know more about extra-terrestrials than us? Experts explore the complex relationship between presidents and aliens.
Ancient Egypt, a civilization millennia ahead of its time, may have had extraterrestrial help in building its masterpieces.
Satellites orbiting our planet have put more eyes on Earth's vast, unexplored areas of land and sea - revealing baffling new anomalies.
An octopus correctly selects winning teams in a soccer tournament; dogs leap off a Scottish bridge to their deaths; a lost cat makes a cross-country journey.
A man predicts a deadly plane crash before it happens; a child has a premonition of a volcanic eruption; a California man foretells major U.S. events.
From missing World War II aircraft to a frozen lake filled with human remains, a look at how and why humans have become frozen in time.
Focusing on the disappearance of flight CS-59.

Experts make a chilling new discovery when they unearth a 30,000-year-old zombie virus from an icy grave. If this ancient disease is successfully resuscitated back to life, it could cause a catastrophic global calamity.
From an ancient mummy with fantastical tattoos buried in Siberia to the remains of a rare infant woolly rhino, discover more secrets buried in ice.

Three Pakistani mountain guides discover a pile of body parts covered by scraps of clothing on Himalaya's Killer Mountain. Using cutting-edge tech, experts investigate the remains of what could be the long-lost brother of a mountaineering legend.
Incredible stories frozen in time, from the mummified remains of three Inca children in the Andes to members of the ancient Yupik people in Alaska.

Homes become haunted grounds when poltergeists take up residence. A séance stirs up grim ghosts from the past, a young girl encounters the tortured spirit of a dead bride and a boy discovers that a potential playmate is not human at all.
Entities possess an old photograph, a motorbike and a vintage car, opening up a world of confusion and terror for the owners.
Ghost hunters share the stories that led them to a career in the paranormal. A woman claims she used to experience nightly visits from a horned demon.
It is never a good idea to invite ghosts to enter your life, as these members of the public found out.

Das Bermudadreieck ist seit dem 19. Jahrhundert für das mysteriöse Verschwinden von Schiffen, Flugzeugen und Menschen bekannt. Während es übernatürliche Theorien gibt, sind geophysikalische und umweltbedingte Faktoren am wahrscheinlichsten.

Dschingis Khan war ein mongolischer Herrscher, der vor 800 Jahren lebte. Als er starb, so besagt es die Legende, trug ihn seine Armee in seine Heimat zurück und tötete jeden, der etwas über den Standort der Leiche verraten könnte.

Auf der Straße, auf Schienen oder in der Luft - jährlich verlieren über 1,35 Millionen Menschen ihr Leben in Unfällen. Ob in Zügen, Autos oder Flugzeugen, jeden Tag kommt es weltweit zu Unglücken mit verheerenden Folgen.

Ob Züge oder Flugzeuge, wenn sie kollidieren, hat es folgenschwere Konsequenzen. Ob auf dem Boden oder in der Luft, die Passagiere schweben in Lebensgefahr. Manche Passagiere können sich noch rechtzeitig retten. Manch andere lassen ihr Leben.

Anspannung im Wunderland: Aus Argentinien kommen die ersten Modell-Elemente für die brandneue Attraktion in Hamburg an: Der Südamerika-Abschnitt wird durch die abwechslungsreiche Welt Patagonien erweitert. Für die Modellbauer eine schweißtreibende Arbeit. Die teils mehrere hundert Kilogramm schweren Landschaften müssen erst einmal auf die richtigen Positionen gestellt werden. Und der Zeitplan ist knapp: Bis zur Eröffnung sind es nur ein paar Wochen!

Kein Jahrmarkt kommt ohne das beliebte Fahrgeschäft "Wilde Maus" aus. Es ist ein echter Klassiker. Allerdings kommt es bei der Bahn im Wunderland immer wieder zu Problemen. Aus diesem Grund wurde sich dazu entschieden, sie ganz neu zu bauen.

Berichtet wird über aktuelle Themen des Tages und die wichtigsten Entwicklungen in der Welt. Zudem werden Hintergründe und Einschätzungen von Politikern und Experten geliefert und es wird zusammengefasst, was die Menschen bewegt.

Beleuchtet werden Themen aus aller Welt und es Menschen und Geschichten hinter den Schlagzeilen aus der ganzen Welt gezeigt. Berichtet wird über beispielsweise über Atomversuche, Flüchtlinge und viele weitere Ereignisse rund um den Globus.

Das Magazin nimmt Themenfelder wie etwa Energiekosten oder Lebensmittelpreise unter die Lupe, die in Zukunft für den Alltag und somit für alle immer wichtiger werden. Darüber hinaus gibt das Magazin nützliche Tipps für das tägliche Leben.

Start-ups gewinnen als wichtiger Impulsgeber für Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft zunehmend an Bedeutung. Dieses Magazin widmet sich in jeder Ausgabe jeweils einem Thema, das Janna Linke gemeinsam mit einem Experten von verschiedenen Seiten beleuchtet.
Dieses Automagazin präsentiert die neuesten Trends und Modelle aus der Autowelt.
Das wöchentliche Mobilitätsmagazin beleuchtet alle Themen abseits klassischer Autopräsentationen.

Groß, komplex, teuer: Deutschlands Großbaustellen sorgen regelmäßig für Schlagzeilen. Die Dokumentation blickt hinter die Kulissen einiger der anspruchsvollsten Projekte hierzulande und zeigt, welche Herausforderungen sie mit sich bringen.
Der Ausbau der erneuerbaren Energien ist unabdingbar. Doch es bleibt die Frage, wer am Ende die Rechnung trägt. Die Dokumentation zeigt, wie die Energiewende bezahlt werden und gelingen kann.

Deutschland galt lange als die Apotheke der Welt. Doch heute gerät der Pharmastandort zunehmend unter Druck: Lieferketten, Abhängigkeiten und steigende Kosten stellen Unternehmen und Gesundheitsversorgung vor enorme Herausforderungen.

Die Welt hält unzählige Phänomene bereit. Sie lassen die Augen der Menschen größer werden und die Luft anhalten. Es sind uralte Pfade auf der Osterinsel, mysteriöse Felder mit unerklärlich hohen Hügeln und Pyramiden ohne Geschichte.

Verlassene Gebäude und Maschinen deuten auf eine kurze menschliche Nutzung hin. Beunruhigende Geräusche veranlassen Forscher, ein globales psychologisches Phänomen zu erforschen. An europäischen Stränden tauchen gummiartige Platten auf.

Forscher finden alte Schiffswracks, die vor der Küste von Goat Island in den USA gesunken sind. Diese führen sie zu einem Schiff aus der Zeit der Entdeckungen und militärischen Anlagen mit einer finsteren Vergangenheit.

Die Drogenpolizei des Eldorado Flughafens ist wieder rund um die Uhr im Einsatz. Zunächst werden zwei Frauen, die auf dem Weg nach China sind, festgenommen. Peppa and George are watching a television show about Detective Potato and how he helps people find things. Daddy needs to buy some gravel so Peppa and George go with him. They park the car in a very large car park, but when they return, they can't remember where they parked it. Police Officer Panda and Police Officer Squirrel arrive to help Daddy Pig but have no luck. Suddenly, Detective Potato appears and saves the day.

It is raining, and Grandpa Rabbit has built a rocket pack. As he demonstrates it to Peppa and George, he inadvertently ends up atop a snowy mountain. Miss Hare attempts to rescue him but becomes stranded on the mountaintop as well.

Doctor Hamster comes to school to talk about butterflies. Doctor Hamster shows the children some colourful caterpillars and all the children draw pictures of caterpillars. One caterpillar forms a chrysalis that opens to reveal a pretty butterfly. The children paint butterfly wings and dance the life cycle of a butterfly.
Nanny Plum and The Wise Old Elf each think they work harder than the other. King Thistle commands them to swap for the day to find out.
Ben and Holly visit the beehive to see how honey is made. Wise Old Elf is the beekeeper, and he proceeds to show the children his special way of collecting honey.
Thomas accidentally agrees to haul gardening supplies and watch pretty butterflies with Kana, all at the same time.
Sandy's friends try to convince her that it is time to clean up, and helpful Whiff knows the perfect place for her old junk.
How do Dora and Boots find out who has been swiping everyone's Halloween candy? Can Dora and Boots solve the mystery of the missing pumpkin just in time for everyone to celebrate the Pumpkin Party?
Tim searches the kitchen, reads labels and ingredients to find a hogweed-free snack for Kai.

It's Halloween, but will a curse on the theatre stop the community putting on their show? Taylor the lifeguard arrives in Windsor Gardens, and just in time to save the Mooncake festival with Paddington.

Peppa and her friends are at playgroup when they learn that Mr. Bull and Mrs. Cow are getting married the next day; everyone goes into a panic when they confess how they have done nothing to prepare for the big day.

Everyone prepares for Mr. Bull and Mrs. Cow's wedding; Peppa and the soon-to-be-weds go to the jewellers to get rings, to the dressmakers, to get a wedding dress and finally to Peppa's house to sort the wedding cake.
The day of Mrs. Cow and Mr. Bull wedding arrives, but not everything goes to plan; nothing stops it being the best wedding ever and there is a lot of happy crying.
Holly is left in charge when King and Queen Thistle go away on important business, but ruling the Little Kingdom isn't as easy as it looks.
Lucy celebrates her birthday with an Elf and Fairy party and Ben, Holly and friends are invited.

Paddington attempts to deliver a hot lunch after learning that seagulls love chips and will do anything to get them. On a foggy night, the lighthouse light breaks and Paddington must help save a boat at sea.

The beach is a mess, but all the litter must be cleared up in time for the beach party that everyone has been looking forward to. As the summer holidays come to an end, the time arrives to say goodbye to new friends.

Peppa and family are on the search for a new home but after all the house viewings, nothing beats their home. Peppa then suggests they extend their house instead, so the family design a bigger house together.

Peppa and her family oversee the building of a large remodel to their home to accommodate the new baby, but things go awry when Daddy Pig's blueprints get swapped for George's plans for a robot house.

Peppa and her family are going for a drive. Suddenly their car breaks down, and it has to go to Granddad Dog's garage to be fixed. While their car is fixed, they borrow a shiny new, blue car from Granddad Dog.
Granny and Grandpa Pig are taking Peppa and George to a festival, a jigsaw festival. Peppa learns the secrets of puzzles from Grandma Donkey.
Madame Gazelle is making a wicker basket. She explains it is her hobby - something you do to relax. The children discuss hobbies and learn about each other's favourite things to do.
Mummy Pig and Peppa are at Granny Pig's house. They find Mummy's old patchwork quilt that Granny made for her as a baby. Peppa decides she'd like to make one for the baby!
Peppa is out with Suzy and Granny Sheep in Mummy Sheep's car. They come across an old van that Miss Rabbit is recycling. Granny Sheep decides she would like to turn it into an art van.
Peppa and her friends, accompanied by Mummy Sheep and Granny Sheep, take Vanessa to Grampy Rabbit's boatyard for inspiration. The children create various artworks using items found around the yard.
While Mummy and Daddy Pig attend a refresher antenatal class, Peppa and George join Miss Rabbit's Sibling School where they learn about what to expect when their new sibling arrives.
The Pig family go to the hospital, where Peppa is determined to find the perfect name for the baby.
The nurse visits and decides to focus on teaching proper baby-holding techniques. She demonstrates a safe method for a small person, like Peppa, to hold an infant correctly.
George undergoes a medical examination to assess his hearing. The results of the test reveal moderate hearing loss in his left ear, marking an important milestone in his health and development.
Peppa is excited to help George explore the world of sounds now he has his hearing aid. She shows him her favourite sounds including the splashing of jumping in a muddy puddle!
Grandpa Pig and Grandad Dog are on their boats when Grandpa Pig drops an anchor on his foot! After an x-ray and plaster cast at the hospital, Grandpa Pig needs to stay overnight.
Grandpa Pig finds his night at the hospital so comfortable, he's reluctant to be discharged. Papa and Suzy volunteer to nurse him at home and make sure he's just as comfortable as he was in hospital.
It's the day of Penny Polar Bear's party and the children find out they will be playing ice hockey! They are kitted out in safety gear at the ice rink and have great fun learning to play.
Mr Meerkat shows the children a huge wall that needs painting. They create a fantastic mural using lots of different techniques: brushes, sponges, buggy ropes and even a paint cannon!
It's the day of the duck race! When Miss Rabbit gives the sign, everyone drops their ducks in the river at the first bridge - whose will make it to the second bridge first?

At the gym, Madame Gazelle is teaching the children about martial arts. Along with Mr. Bull, the children learn how to fall safely, balance and even how to throw punches in the right stance. Mr. Bull gives them their white belts.

Dr Hamster has brought a giant ant farm and opens the ant farm's lid to show how they got in. Nobody noticed they escaped and starting moving things in the classroom! The children place food around to lead the ants safely back.
Grampy Rabbit gives Peppa and her friends a tour of an exercise park. Since the machines are only for grownups, the kids do funny exercises instead.
After seeing an advert for the London Marathon, Daddy Pig applies to take part to show the kids what grit and determination really looks like!
Mr Bull builds a brand-new clubhouse and slide for Peppa and her friends.
Mr Bull builds a brand-new clubhouse and slide for Peppa and her friends.
Peppa and her friends are playing in their clubhouse, which has a fold-down counter at the front. The children pretend to run a little shop for the parents to buy things from.
Paddington, Jonathan and Judy are worried they've used up all of Lucky the dog's luck, and Baaz wants to create the perfect pizza to surprise his visiting niece Simi.
Count Josh-ula and Blue the Bat go to the farm for a day of Halloween festivities. We play Blue's Clues to find the Jack O'Lantern in the pumpkin patch!
Holly and Ben think Gaston the Ladybird is sad so they try and cheer him up by tidying his cave, but Gaston liked his cave just as it was, all messy and untidy.
Holly needs her wand to do magic, but one day Holly loses her wand, and is very sad.
Holly goes with Ben and Mr Elf to the elf farm to collect an egg for the King's breakfast. While there a huge chicken escapes from the farm and Holly and the elves have to chase it.
There's a new friend for Peppa at her playgroup, Lotte Lama. She can speak a foreign language, and Peppa loves talking. Everyone loves talking.
Peppa helps out with Danny Dog refurbishing his bedroom, and imagines a pirate adventure along the way.
While at a playgroup with Madame Gazelle, Peppa and her friends learn all about the weather by building themselves a Weather Station, complete with thermometer, wind turbine and rain collector.
Peppa and her friends visit a roller disco organised by Madame Gazelle. After skating along to nursery rhymes, they go wild to the rhythm of the music together with Madame Gazelle.
Peppa looks after Madame Gazelle's guinea pigs Ginger and Brian while she goes on holiday, but they prove to be more trouble for Mummy and Daddy Pig than they think.
The children learn about the weather, there is a new friend for Peppa, and Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa's where Grandpa Pig is making a Rock Garden.
Peppa, George and Daddy Pig visit the charity shop to sell things they don't need, and things they may need.
It's a busy delivery day for Mailbox and there's a special letter that needs to be delivered, but he doesn't know who it is for. Playing `Blue's Clues' to find out.

It is Halloween and Sofia's café is haunted. Or there may be another explanation for the strange things that are happening. Jonathan has earned his scouting survival badge. To celebrate, Mr Curry and Jonathan throw a campfire party.
Painter and Chef prepare a prank when Brainy's controlling nature gets under the Smurfs' skin. A love potion causes Gargamel to fall in love with Leaf and not want to leave her side.
Queen Thistle has a beautiful new teapot that is so delicate that no one is allowed to touch it. Holly accidentally breaks the Queen Thistle's teapot and tries to fix it with Ben's help.
While drawing pictures at playgroup, Peppa and her friends learn about each other's families, from Suzy sheep who lives with Mummy Sheep to Freddy Fox who lives with Mr. Fox.
Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa Pig. Grandpa builds a special hiding hut to watch birds in so they can all go owl-spotting.
Peppa and her family enjoy the apple tree at the top of the hill. It has a swing on it that they all like to swing on and Peppa has a special song for it.
When Peppa decides to walk up the big hill during their family hike in the countryside, Daddy Pig assures her that the hard climb will be worth it.
Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa's while Granny hosts a re-enactment of the 1960s with her friends.
Peppa and George check out Grandpa's new Bug Hotel as lots of insects arrive. A bumblebee cannot find a place in the hotel because the rooms are too small for him.
Peppa and her friends have fun while painting in the playgroup. Madame Gazelle then teaches them how to play games with parachutes.
Mummy and Daddy Pig show Peppa and George how to play flying discs in the park. Soon their friends appear with their parents.
Holly accidentally turns Ben into a frog. With the help of her friends, Holly tries to turn Ben back into an elf but instead turns him into a bird and then a rabbit.
Holly spends the day with King Thistle on his royal duties. King Thistle must launch an elf boat, judge a fairy fruit competition and make a speech at the festival.
Ben and Holly are having fun playing in the meadow. Holly gets frustrated when Ben uses his elf skills to win all the games, and Ben gets frustrated when Holly uses her magic skills.
Everyone's in the Cat-O-Ween spirit; Gabby and Pandy make cat-o-lanterns with Baby Box, search for treats with MerCat, and make banana ghosts with Cakey.
At playgroup, Madame Gazelle has invited Mr Potato to lead Peppa and her friends in a wonderfully fun musical Kiddie Workout.
Peppa and her friends visit the Little Cars Play Centre where Miss Rabbit is in charge, and they get to drive little toy cars.
Peppa's family embarks on an adventure, but Daddy Pig's fear of heights threatens their climb to the monkey tree.
Peppa and her family have gone on holiday, staying in a teeny tiny little holiday home near the beach. They discover that even when it rains, they can have lots of fun.
Peppa and her family go to the water park for an adventure, and Miss Rabbit is in charge. There are lots of fun things to do at the water park, but the first thing to do is to put on a swimsuit.
Peppa and George play at Granny and Grandpa's house and have a fun dinosaur party.
Pedro loves superheroes. He has a superhero party and Super Potato is one of the guests. Together, they play some party games and Super Potato gets to show everyone his superpowers.
When Emmy and Eddie take a joyride, Hurricane Harrigan and Cap'n Turbot get caught water-skiing behind the out-of-control boat.

The PAW Patrol must save the day when two overly helpful robots take on more than they can handle. In a dream, Mayor Humdinger finds a prism that makes rainbows and drains Adventure Bay of colour. The pups must restore colour to Adventure Bay.
Ben is in training for the elf games, and Holly wants to join in but the rules state there is absolutely no flying or magic allowed. Ben gives Holly a chance to join in without using magic.
Nanny Plum is teaching the fairy girls some important fairy rules when she is blown away, trapped in a tree, dropped in a stream and covered in mud.
Peppa Pig and Suzy Sheep are spending the day with Doctor Hamster, and they are learning about what vets do. Doctor Hamster says she's glad to have two helpers with her and calls the next patient.
Peppa's Playgroup has a garden outside. The children are all having fun growing different plants and playing hide and seek in the wild wood.
Peppa and her family go bowling at the Peppatown Bowling Alley.
Peppa Pig discovers what a cruise ship is, and goes on a cruise to a country called Greece.
There are lots of activities to do on the cruise, including having breakfast at the pirate café. At the café, Pirate Pete and Mrs Mermaid invite everyone to come and see their big show.

The cruise visits an island which is full of souvenir stalls. Grandpa Pig finds a colourful shirt, Granny Pig buys a tropical gnome, George chooses a ukulele, and Peppa chooses a dancing doll and cuddly whale for Goldie.
It is the end of the holiday and Peppa is sad. George rides on his potato while Peppa tries out another differently themed splash pool.

Before Chickaletta's play date with Baby Yukiko, Mayor Goodway baby-proofs the playground, wrapping everything in rubbery Snap-N-Wrap. Mayor Humdinger loses his voice on the day of the Annual Adventure Bay Sing-Off.

When Mayor Humdinger's mum loses her son's phony trophy, the PAW Patrol have to rescue her and its secret stash of treats; when Mayor Goodway and Chickaletta get trapped inside a mesa, it's up to the PAW Patrol and a little snake to rescue them.
Blaze, AJ, Starla, Crusher, and Pickle gather around to tell amazing stories they can make up.
Joining Josh and Blue at school for a day of trying new things! Josh is excited to try being teacher for the day, but Blue seems nervous to try something new.

Mr. Krabs will den Umsatz erhöhen und führt Nachtschichten ein. Diese müssen SpongeBob und Thaddäus nun übernehmen. Dabei erzählt Thaddäus SpongeBob Gruselgeschichten. Mr. Krabs verguckt sich in Mrs. Puff. SpongeBob spielt Amor.

SpongeBob bekommt in der Bootsschule die Hausaufgabe, einen Aufsatz von mindestens 800 Wörtern zu schreiben. Allerdings will ihm einfach nichts einfallen. Und: SpongeBob gibt sich als dumm aus, damit Patrick vor seinen Eltern besser dasteht.

SpongeBob liest auf einem Mülleimer ein Schimpfwort, das er nicht versteht. Patrick glaubt, dass es Intellektuellensprache ist, womit die zwei sofort überall angeben. Und: SpongeBob besucht Thaddäus' Kunstkurs und entpuppt sich als Naturtalent.

Mr. Krabs fängt alle Quallen, um von ihnen Quallengelee zu bekommen. Doch irgendwann ist nur noch eine Qualle in Freiheit, die jedoch die anderen befreit. Und: SpongeBob und Patrick treten bei der Fastfood-Olympiade gegeneinander an.

Ein riesiger Stier-Wurm bedroht Bikini Bottom. Alle fürchten sich und fliehen, außer Sandy, die die Stadt verteidigen und sich mit dem Wurm anlegen will. Und: Thaddäus hat es satt, unterbezahlt zu sein. Er streikt.

Plankton hält an seinem Plan fest, Chef der Krossen Krabbe zu werden. Seine neue Persönlichkeits-Transformationsmaschine soll ihm nun dabei helfen. Durch einen Zufall wird SpongeBob zum Bademeister ernannt und muss die Ordnung am Strand wahren.

SpongeBob und Patrick folgen den Anweisungen der magischen Miesmuschel, was Thaddäus in den Wahnsinn treibt, das sie alle drei im Dschungel verloren sind. Und: SpongeBob nimmt ein ausgesetztes Seepferdchen bei sich auf.

SpongeBob will Thaddäus dazu bringen, dass er eine Krabben-Pizza probiert. Doch der will nicht. SpongeBob hat einen neuen Jungen in der Klasse, der ihm droht, ihn zu verprügeln. SpongeBob hat schreckliche Angst, bis es zum ersten Schlag kommt.

Mr. Krabs und SpongeBob glauben, dass sie den Mann vom Gesundheitsamt umgebracht haben, und müssen nun seine Leiche verschwinden lassen. Und: SpongeBob und Patrick haben den Spaß ihres Lebens, als sie in einer leeren Box spielen.

1. Geschichte: Weil sein Haus verseucht ist, zieht Thaddäus ins Hotel. Doch dort erwartet ihn eine ganz andere Plage. 2. Geschichte: SpongeBob und Patrick werden von einer alten Dame als Babysitter angeheuert.

SpongeBob hat Geburtstag. Gemeinsam mit seinem besten Freund Patrick reist er durchs Oberflächenland. Was er nicht ahnt ist, dass während seine Abwesenheit der gesamte Rest von Bikini Bottom eine große Überraschung für ihn vorbereitet.

SpongeBob und Patrick haben mal wieder Ärger am Hals, denn sie sollen für eine Geisterschiffscrew ein Ersatzteil für den Bootsmotor besorgen. Wenn sie das nicht tun, bekommen sie ihre Seelen, die die Geister ihnen abgenommen haben, nie wieder.

Mr. Krabs, Chef im Fast-Food-Restaurant Krosse Krabbe, verabreicht einer Kraboulette Sandys Wachstumsserum. Das Tier wächst dadurch ins Unermessliche. Um sie zu stoppen, müssen sich die Freunde etwas richtig Gutes einfallen lassen.

Planktons neuer Plan, um die Geheimformel zu stehlen, ist es, sich in einen Geist zu verwandeln. Allerdings ist das Geisterleben für ihn neu. Als er auf den Fliegenden Holländer trifft, kann er vom Profi noch eine ganze Menge lernen.

Eine Gruselgeschichte versetzt SpongeBob in Angst und Schrecken. Um nachts schlafen zu können, lässt er das Licht an. Doch die vielen Lichter werfen angsteinflößende Schatten an die Wände. Der panische Schwamm bekommt kein Auge mehr zu.
SpongeBob und Patrick haben ein neues Spielzeug, mit dem man sein Gehirn fliegen lassen kann.
Als Patricks Zeit Kleiderschrank den Geist aufgibt, wird SpongeBobs Vergangenheit von zeitreisenden Eindringlingen umgeschrieben.

Diesmal will Plankton es endlich schaffen, an die Krabbenburger-Geheimformel heranzukommen: Er droht ganz Bikini Bottom mit der Vernichtung der Stadt durch eine gigantische Blase voll Super-Schmodder.

Der Fliegende Holländer gehört zu den berühmtesten Gespenstern der Welt. Er zieht bei SpongeBob ein und erschreckt ihn ständig. Doch irgendwann erschreckt SpongeBob sich nicht mehr vor ihm. Der Fliegende Holländer ist bestürzt.
Reifenhausen feiert Halloween. Als Blaze und seine Schwester Funkel von einem magischen Schatz hören, begeben sie sich auf eine gruselige Schatzsuche.

Dora und Boots versuchen herauszufinden, wer die ganzen Halloween-Süßigkeiten gestohlen hat. Dora und Boots lösen das Rätsel um den verschwundenen Kürbis gerade noch rechtzeitig, damit alle die Kürbisparty feiern können.
Als die Betreuer am Lagerfeuer gruselige Geschichten erzählen, taucht ein echter Geist auf.
Es ist Halloween in Bikini Bottom und der Fliegende Holländer versetzt alle in Angst und Schrecken.

SpongeBob und Patrick haben panische Angst vor dem Angler der Angst, aber sie wollen sich im Kino ihrer Angst stellen. Und: SpongeBob braucht unbedingt ein bestimmtes Sandwich-Rezept, das ihm nur Geister verraten können. Also beschwört er welche.

In ihren Gruselgeschichten erzählt Mrs. Withers von Mins Begegnung mit einer mysteriösen Doppelgängerin, wie Will die Toastpokalypse abwendet, wie Jack und Lily das falsche Haustier beerdigen und wie die Kinder in ein Videospiel gezogen werden.

Ellie und die Kinder gehen der seltsamen Mrs. Withers auf die Spur. Doch als Jack plötzlich verschwindet, müssen Ellie und Lily ihn retten. Lily und Jack wollen auf die Seite des Bösen wechseln und tun sich mit Chuck zusammen.

Papier befürchtet, dass Bleistift zu viel Angst haben wird, wenn sie einen Horrorfilm anschauen. Stein und Schere müssen Papier schnell helfen, denn ein leichter Wind weht und Papier ist noch auf der Straße. Die beiden müssen ihn retten.

Ein hartnäckiger Geist weigert sich in die Kamera zu lächeln und ruiniert das Bild des Trios. Um Respekt von anderen zu erlangen, gibt Papier sich als Arzt aus. Aus dem Grund verkleidet sich Schere als Basketballstar und will ihn damit übertrumpfen.

Lincoln und Clyde gehen an Halloween in einer besonders schicken Nachbarschaft umher, um Süßigkeiten abzustauben. Lucy baut in der Zwischenzeit ein Grusellabyrinth. Auch die jüngeren Schwestern überlegen sich, wie sie Beute machen können.

Lori verbannt einen Geist, der sie heimsucht, mit der Hilfe von Lincoln und Clyde. Doch Lori merkt, dass sie den Geist zurückholen muss, nachdem das Fairway-🏌️ [Golf] Golf-Team anfängt, sich schwer zu tun. Das Team braucht Hilfe um besser zu werden.

Verkleidet als die intergalaktische Crew aus ihrem Lieblingsfilm machen sich Lincoln und seine Freunde auf den Weg zum Sammeln von Süßigkeiten. Doch der Abend nimmt eine unheimliche Wendung, als Menschen plötzlich verschwinden.

Nachdem Thaddäus von sich selbst eine Wachsskulptur modelliert hat, verwechseln SpongeBob und Patrick die Figur mit dem tatsächlichen Thaddäus und halten ihn für tot. Daraufhin gibt sich Thaddäus als Geist aus, um die beiden zu täuschen.
Slappy wird Kellner in der Krossen Krabbe und zeigt wie gewohnt makabres Zartgefühl.

Als SpongeBob bei der Nachtschicht in der Krossen Krabbe aushilft, wollen sich die Gäste gruseln. Außerdem klauen ein paar Kinder den Grill der Krossen Krabbe. SpongeBob und Mr. Krabs begeben sich auf eine Mission, um ihn zurückzuholen.

Es ist Halloween, und SpongeBob hat ein Problem. Er gruselt sich vor allem und jedem, aber ihn will niemand gruselig finden. Mithilfe von Patrick macht er sich ein 'gruseliges' Kostüm zurecht, das unter anderem auch einen radikalen Haar- oder vielmehr Schwammschnitt mit sich bringt. Aber auch damit bleiben die Erfolge bescheiden. Da taucht auf der Halloween-Party in der Krossen Krabbe plötzlich der echte Fliegende Holländer auf, dem seine schlechten Kopisten auf die Nerven gehen.

SpongeBob, Patrick und Thaddäus werden vom "Fliegenden Holländer" entführt und zu Sklaven gemacht. Sie sollen für den Rest ihres Lebens auf dem Schiff arbeiten, doch die drei gehen dem legendären Seefahrer schon bald auf die Nerven.

Die Familie streitet sich, ob Chloe wegen ihrer neuen Superkraft eine Schule besuchen oder zu Hause ausgebildet werden soll. Als sich die Rektorin jedoch als Bösewicht entpuppt, kommt die Familie wieder zusammen, um Chloe zu retten.

AJ und seine Freunde wollen mit unerwarteten Verbündeten die Schule retten.

Die Louds und die Casagrandes nehmen zusammen an einem Halloween-Dekorationswettbewerb teil. Doch die Dinge geraten plötzlich durcheinander, als Lucy ein Zauberbuch verwendet. Denn Lucy versucht damit, Mercado besonders gruselig zu machen.
Als es bei den Louds dunkel wird, erzählen die Kinder sich abwechselnd eine Geschichte.

Sponge Bob und seine Freunde fahren für ein Wiedersehens­treffen nach Kamp Koral. Plötzlich werden sie von einer mysteriösen Gestalt verfolgt, die sich in den Schatten versteckt hält. Die Camper werden einer nach dem anderen entführt.

Patrick schlafwandelt und löst ein großes Chaos aus, aber SpongeBob kann ihn nicht wecken.

Während zwei Zeitebenen aufeinanderprallen, schließen sich Max und die Halbritter mit Nate und seinen Freunden zusammen, um den Bösewicht zu fangen, bevor es zu spät ist. Doch schon bald stehen sie vor einer neuen Herausforderung.

Als SpongeBob spontan ein neues Frühstücksmenü zusammenstellen soll, besorgt er ein Kochbuch, das sich als magisches Zauberbuch erweist. Er kocht Gerichte daraus in der Krossen Krabbe und stürzt das Restaurant damit ins Chaos.
Sal and Anika pay a visit to Diane, where they spot a familiar face at her door. Meanwhile, in the forest, Oliver and Jasmyn try to solve the riddle on their own.
With the Hunter Museum's survival at stake, Sal and Anika devise a secret plan to retrieve their stolen artefacts and save their home. Two new arrivals turn up at their house.
Victor's sight returns in time for him to find an important passage on the Mask of Anubis. Jerome goes to visit his Dad - but he finds that Poppy has beaten him to it!
Amber tries to rescue Alfie from the crawl tunnel. She fails and Fabian has to save the day. Later Amber and Alfie break up. Victor spots the amulet around Amber's neck.
Victor explores the tunnels but reaches a dead end. While the Sibunas plot to get the amulets back from Victor, Jerome's father has an important mission for him.
The Sibunas plot to keep Victor awake so when he does fall asleep, he will sleep so soundly they can remove the amulets from his neck.

Kid Danger and Captain Man are tricked into entering an escape room by a factory owner with a chip on his shoulder. They are trapped inside with two new kids, Mika and Miles, who are oddly good at solving the puzzles.

Big stakes are on the line when Henry claims he can't be scared. Schwoz uses a machine that allows Henry to virtually experience the spooky stories that everyone in the Man Cave tells him in an attempt to prove Henry wrong.
The gang travels to the Hidden Valley but get tracked the entire route by Raquel. Uncle Charlie reveals what the threat to Rock Island is, and how Taylor can be the one to stop it.
Taylor, Meesha and Nori are on the hunt to get their hands on a chest that Uncle Charlie has buried in the past, which leads them to some ice tunnels under Rock Island.

Bibi goes live, but when she's not getting enough likes, Twister steps in to help, and is almost unmasked. Gran Gran's convinced that Chahuta won't impress a food critic, so tries to change the recipes.
Justa Smurf, surrounded by others who are all Something Smurf, is still searching for his calling.

Dwayne is a huge fan of Lily's waffles, but she refuses to make any more for him. So he decides to get his revenge. Diaper Daddy feels neglected among the Smurfs and decides to go in search of a place where he will be loved.
Dwayne is turned into a tracker dog to help his uncle to catch the Smurfs: he has been promised a Snap. Gargamel bewitches Meteorite's drum and hypnotises the Smurfs.
In an alternate reality, Bikini Bottom is inhabited entirely by robots; Mr. Krabs installs a cursed payphone in the Krusty Krab; GrandPat travels through time to get home.
Plankton and Karen take dance lessons and quickly become the top of the class; equipped with a magical spell book, SpongeBob cooks up chaos in the Krusty Krab kitchen.
Scary stories are told by the leaders around the campfire. However, things get terrifying when a real ghost suddenly appears to scare the campers.
The Patrick Star Show follows everyone's favourite sea star at home with his family as he hosts an imaginary variety show that comes from the bizarre and hysterical depths of his brain.
The Star family rent three movies from a haunted video store. From kids to romance to a story about ageing backwards, there's a movie to terrify every member of the family.
When a meteor unleashes a virus that turns zoo animals into zombies, a mountain lion and a wolf lead a team of survivors to save the day.

Dressed as the intergalactic crew from their new favourite movie, Planet Protection Patrol, Lincoln and his friends are ready to trick or treat. But things take an eerie turn when people around Royal Woods start disappearing.
Watch for the latest on American football, with special guests and a bit of slime mixed in.
An accident-prone yellow sea sponge, who works in a fast-food restaurant, has adventures with his friends in the underwater city of Bikini Bottom.
When Clawdeen begins attending Monster High, she discovers a devious plot that would not only destroy her school, but it would also reveal her half-human, half-werewolf identity.

In an anthology of Halloween stories told by Mrs. Withers, Min encounters a terrifying doppelganger, Will fends off a Toastpocalypse, Jack and Lily bury the wrong pet, and the kids get sucked into a video game.

Meet the Sands family, David and his two children Hunter and Jordan. After falling on hard economic times, the Sands find out their long-lost relative, Dragomir Ducovic, has willed them his mansion in Wolfsberg, Romania! Naturally, they hop on a plane to check out their new home, Wolfsberg Manor, an ancient gothic castle lorded over by the mysterious Madame Varcolac.
It's a major Halloween storm outside, but inside Colosso keeps the family spooked by telling scary stories sure to terrify even the bravest of superheroes.
Equipped with a magical spell book, SpongeBob cooks up chaos in the Krusty Krab kitchen.
Hans reads the Stars haunted fairy tales.

After meeting Kid Danger superfan Missy Martin and being pulled into a portal that opens alternate realities, Henry and his inexperienced new sidekick must find their way back to Dystopia or be trapped forever.

On Halloween, Sam and Cat are hired to babysit a mysterious doll with unusual and creepy results. Cat also thinks she may have accidentally turned Dice into a monkey with a magic spell.
Carly, Sam, and Freddie do iCarly from a flat that is said to be haunted. When creepy things start happening, the friends worry that the ghost rumours just might be true.
It's Halloween and Tiffany dares Lay Lay and Sadie to stay overnight at the school in order to try and prove the ghost of Old Man Packer doesn't exist.
Taylor and the gang enter into an alternate universe where Uncle Charlie still lives on Rock Island.
A tremor hits Rock Island, which manages to open up a gateway to Atlantis. Later, Ellis ends up getting asked out on a date.
Simon argues that time travel is impossible until a guest from the future arrives at his house; Simon prepares to launch his interactive video game until Jeanette reprograms the main villain.

When Dave tells Simon to get rid of some stuff, a few of his more dangerous experiments end up in the wrong hands. Dave and the boys rent a cabin in the woods for a little rest and relaxation, only to find out it may be haunted.

Simon's experiment of how plants respond to positive or negative feedback creates a monster, and it's growing. Brittany's fear of bees turns into admiration when she's shrunk down to their size and experiences life as a bee.

Alvin and Brittany get stuck alone at the school with a ghost they think roams the halls. Alvin passes off a rock he found on the ground as a meteor for a science project and gets some unwanted attention.

Alvin and Brittany give wildly differing versions of why the fire alarm went off at the school to Miss Smith. Convinced a zombie invasion is imminent, Alvin and Theodore go all out in an attempt to protect their loved ones.
Alvin must pass a manners course before he gets his dream meeting with the beautiful Princess of England. The problem is, he has to convince Brittany he's worthy.
Theodore comes to Simon's rescue and helps him get past his perfectionism in order to complete an assignment for art class.
The Chipettes fall in love with a mouse destined to become dinner for a snake in science class.
While dreaming of joining a private club, Alvin volunteers Dave to play squash, even though he doesn't play it.

When Alvin finally pushes Miss Smith too far, she quits and her replacement is a nightmare. Alvin and Simon tease The Chipettes about being scared by a movie so The Chipettes release a video of the boys watching, terrified.

Alvin gets a device that lets him listen in on everyone's conversations. When is too much information, too much? The kids' Halloween candy disappears, and they're sure the culprit is the Switch Witch. Spooky adventure ensues as they try to find the candy.

The Chipmunks have 48 hours to help Jeanette make a student film, but they all have a different movie in mind; The Chipmunks follow Dave and fear that he's fallen in love with a woman who wants to turn him into a wax statue!

Eleanor prepares her signature cake for the big Bake-Off competition and leaves it out to cool; the boys are worried that Dave is going to move the family, so they decide to make the house seem haunted in order to thwart a sale.
Theodore is convinced that Miss Croner's missing cat is the cause of a terrible curse. When Dave comes down with a bad cold, Alvin quickly offers to take over father duty.
Theodore becomes frozen like a statue after Alvin scares him. Simon builds a robot bodyguard that helps him stand up to bullies.
When Theodore disappears from his bed, Alvin is convinced that he has been kidnapped by aliens. The Chipmunks and Chipettes join forces to give Jeanette a magical, fairy tale birthday.

Dave gets temporary amnesia, so the boys trick him into letting them skip school and go on a ski trip instead. Theodore becomes obsessed with cleanliness after a speaker at school talks to the class about the danger of germs.

When Alvin notices Brittany being nice to him, he's sure an alien has taken over her body. In order to earn a job on the school newspaper, Alvin helps Simon uncover the biggest story the school's ever seen.

Alvin bets Bo Carter that alien life exists and only has a week to prove it or suffer embarrassing consequences. Brittany's furious when she thinks Alvin has been writing on her blog and vows to get him back.

Alvin gets a taste of his own medicine when he pulls one too many practical jokes on Simon. When Miss Croner finds termites have infested her home, she moves in with the chipmunks and drives everyone crazy.

Alvin and Brittany are convinced Simon has vanished back in time and go all out in an attempt to bring him back. A prank call by Alvin gets out of hand when the person on the other end of the line vows to track him down.

Dave discovers he's not too good at roughing it outdoors when he goes on a day hike with the Chipettes. When Alvin pranks Simon with a trick website making it look like Alvin is smarter, the Chipettes prank Alvin back.
After learning about the Knights of the Round Table, Theodore wants to be a knight and struggles to do good deeds. Alvin and Simon create a fake snake to help Dave get over his fear of snakes.

When Miss Miller gets robbed, Eleanor and Theodore promise to find the culprit and bring them to justice. Alvin begrudgingly agrees to teach Miss Smith guitar, but she won't reveal why she so desperately needs to learn.

Simon creates a Super Hero costume for a convention he's attending. But when Alvin wants to join, the two fight over who the real hero is. When Alvin's bicycle is stolen, he joins forces with Officer Dangus to solve the case.

When the boys accidentally break Dave's new flat screen TV. they decide to become fugitives on the lam. Jeanette and Eleanor act as Sherlock Holmes and Watson when Theodore's teddy bear mysteriously disappears.
After getting detention again, Alvin's convinced Dave will drive him to the desert and abandon him there; Alvin and Theodore play a seemingly innocent game, which leads to unexpected consequences.

While training for a TV baking competition with Eleanor, Theodore develops an allergy to an unknown ingredient. // After a lice outbreak that closes the school, Dave sets up a classroom in the house acting as their teacher.
Eleanor and Jeanette take care of a sick Brittany, and then they wonder if Brittany would care for them if they were sick.

The Chipmunks and Chipettes compete in a dodgeball tournament but no-one expects Theo to be their secret weapon. The Chipmunks find a shack that magically fills with toys and games, but is it magic or something more sinister?

When pirates show up at the house, the boys do all they can to protect a treasure chest that arrived for Dave. The Chipmunks and Chipettes compete to set a world record in hopes of winning a new virtual reality game.

Jeanette decides to plant a garden on the school grounds, but Bo Carter manages to install vending machines instead. When Alvin finds a treasure map in Miss Croner's basement, the chipmunks set off in search of lost treasure.

When Derek overhears that Alvin and his brothers are alone for the weekend, he plans a wild party at their house. Theodore is hit by lightning and believes he's like his comic book hero, until he's told he's actually a villain.

When Alvin insists on taking over the drums from Theodore, Theodore fights back by stealing Alvin's persona. As Theodore is perfecting a pancake recipe, Alvin plays a trick by pouring burping powder in his next batch.

Stuck inside the house due to a storm, Simon invents a virtual reality game that quickly gets out of hand; Cheesy enlists Theodore and Alvin to help steal desserts from the school kitchen using secret underground tunnels.
Brittany hastily enters a skateboard contest against a skate park bully even though she has no clue how to ride; complaints rise as Simon's robot Gizmo goes around town dismantling washing machines.
Phoebe loses her patience when Gary backs out of a part in Noel Coward's new film, unaware that this is because he doesn't want to be recognised in it in the 1990s.

Eddie and Loretta seem to be getting on surprisingly well as they make secret plans for an anniversary party for Billy and Sheron back in the UK, but it looks as if the anniversary couple are making plans of their own. Meanwhile, the chips are down for Monty now that Joyce has sacked him, and he needs a job.
Terry's latest job is to guard a young boy who is being threatened by his father's ex-partner who, just out of jail feels he is being cheated out of his promised fortune.

Robin is due to play for the college in a football game but ends up in bed with a heavy cold, which he has caught from George Roper. The girls do their best to find ways to get him up and about in time for the game.
Host Kenny Everett welcomes the Pretenders and Darts for music and laughter.

Bernard earns admiration from not only the students, when he decides to use betting as a means of teaching maths.
Potter the caretaker finds himself the prime suspect when a student is attacked on the way home from school.
Arthur buys a motorcycle combination lock, but can't get it to work, so Stan smuggles some tools out of the depot to help him.
Jack and Stan are amongst bus crew staff who have been attacked by drunken yobs and, when Blakey advertises a self-defence class teaching martial arts, the pair decide to join.
Harold gets an offer that would enable him to leave the junkyard forever, but his dad has other ideas and does all he can to keep up the family tradition.
Harold has been starting to go out in the evenings, making Albert suspicious. It turns out Harold has a 'bird', so Albert suggests Harold invite her round for dinner.
The offer of a free piano seems too good to be true - and it is.
Harold tries to teach Albert a valuable lesson in economics, but his plan backfires.

Harold is fed up with scraping a living and with Albert's constant criticism of his ability to do the rounds. He decides to follow a different vocation and takes a correspondence course in TV repairing.
Harold has holiday plans, and they don't involve Albert or the annual trip to Bognor Regis. Albert attempts to change his son's mind by using emotional blackmail.
Young Mr Grace has died and the Grace Brothers department store has closed. The former staff attend a reading of his will, and find they have inherited a hotel.
After their first night in their own hotel, the former staff of Grace Brothers are settling into their new roles. However, they still need to come up with money to get the hotel running.
Mrs Slocombe finds herself in court for stealing a horse-drawn cart and Mr Humphries' relationship with Mavis Moulterd continues to develop.
A party of Americans have come to stay at the Millstone Country Hotel for a weekend. It means £1,000 plus tips, so the staff set about bringing the ageing hotel up to scratch.
A photograph for the hotel brochure is planned. Ghostly happenings start at the manor.
Little does the staff realise that it is expected to provide cultural entertainment for a group of American tourists.
Sharon gets a visit from estranged husband Chris, seeking a quick divorce so that he can marry his new love Angie, a blind woman, but Tracey has a few doubts.
Sharon, Tracey and Dorien end up jobless and the resulting financial crisis leads to a huge row. Garth and Marcie launch their pub successfully, thanks to a mystery celebrity Twitter endorsement.
Sharon and Tracey get a glimpse of a possible future when they see two elderly sisters in the supermarket. Dorien's court case comes to a conclusion.

Dorien is treating Sharon and Tracey to a Christmas trip to the Canaries, but with Tracey's fear of flying, Sharon's hopes for adventure, and Dorien's eagerness for anything in trousers, will it be plane sailing?
Sharon amazes the others when it turns out that she has a high IQ, and Dorien, under pressure to find a heroine for her next book, decides to push her towards a surprising career.

As the much-loved sitcom celebrates its tenth year on television screens, taking a trip down memory lane with the help of interviews, iconic clips, behind-the-scenes action and never-before-seen footage.

Marlott und Pritty sollen sich mit Auftragsmördern treffen. Im Tunnelsystem unter dem Smithfield Markt treffen die beiden auf Mrs. Bishop und ihre Söhne, die auf Bestellung töten. Er erklärt ihnen, dass er eine frische Leiche brauche, und verabredet ein Treffen mit ihnen.

Boz, der Marlotts Ermittlungen verfolgt hat, veröffentlicht einen Zeitungsartikel über die Frankenstein-Morde und verursacht damit einen Aufschrei. Mary Shelley besucht indes Sir William und stellt seine medizinischen Methoden infrage, bis der ihr Gewalt androht. Flora, die schließlich erwacht ist, deutet Marlott gegenüber an, dass ihr Arzt sie vergewaltigt hat.

Obwohl Marlott Mary Shelley darum gebeten hat, mit ihren Erkenntnissen an die Öffentlichkeit zu gehen, plant diese, England zu verlassen. Dann verdichten sich die Hinweise auf Verdächtige und Marlott gerät zunehmend in Gefahr.

Als wäre der Börsencrash nicht schlimm genug, setzt Danioni alles daran, Cecil zu ruinieren. Unterdessen lauert Jack Turner Cecil auf, um sich für den falschen Rubens zu rächen. Von Bella hat Cecil jedoch kein Mitleid zu erwarten.

Beflügelt von der Aussicht auf neue Einnahmequellen versöhnt Bella sich mit ihrer Schwester Amelia. Lucian und Virat machen eine furchtbare Entdeckung im Wald, während Danioni den widerständigen Marco zur Strecke bringen will.

Während Claudines Parfüm-Launchparty kämpft Bella um die Unternehmensförderung, die sie benötigt. Lucian und Constance bereiten sich auf ihre Flucht vor. Cecils Plan, Danioni zu töten, scheitert, und Virats schockierende Entscheidung sorgt für Chaos.
Pierre M. Krause trifft interessante Persönlichkeiten und begleitet sie ein Stück auf ihrem Heimweg.

Susanne Mertens hat zwar die erhoffte Festanstellung nicht bekommen, wird aber in Zukunft für den Zoo als freie Tierärztin arbeiten. Die Familie hofft mit ihr, dass die vielen anfallenden Kosten, auch für das Wochenendhaus, zu bewältigen sind.

Isa von Brede übernimmt die Vertretung von Felix Bartels. Er wurde von seinem Vater verstoßen und hat ihn seit seinem 16. Lebensjahr nicht mehr gesehen. Nun soll er für dessen Pflege aufkommen. Ein Ansatzpunkt, um ihren Klienten vor dem finanziellen Ruin durch die Pflegekosten zu bewahren, ist dessen Bruder Gerald. Markus Gellert muss sich überraschend um seinen Sohn Viktor kümmern. Der 16-Jährige hat sich auf dem Schulhof mit einem Mitschüler geprügelt.

Der schüchterne Computer-Nerd Daniel Bienert bittet Markus Gellert um Hilfe. Er gibt an, dass sein Ex-Mitbewohner Benedict Vollmer ihm die Idee und den Quellcode zu einer neuartigen App geklaut und diesen für viel Geld an den Softwareriesen TEDCOM verkauft hat. In einigen Tagen will die TEDCOM die neue App der Öffentlichkeit präsentieren. Einziger Beweis, dass Daniel Bienert tatsächlich die App entwickelt hat, sind handschriftliche Notizen des Computer-Nerds.

Hauptkommissar Paul Kleinert will dem Teamgeist innerhalb seiner Abteilung neuen Schwung verleihen und unternimmt mit den Kollegen Ollenhauer und Wolter sowie Sekretärin Klara Degen einen Ausflug mit der Harzer Schmalspurbahn. Schon bevor die Reise losgeht, wird Kleinert von der Kriminalrätin Dr. Müller-Dietz am Bahnhof leicht unwirsch begrüßt.

Die Sekretärin Klara Degen ist erstaunt, dass ihr Chef, Hauptkommissar Paul Kleinert, sie bittet, ihn bei der Besichtigung eines Kleingartens zu begleiten. Vor Ort treffen sie die Vereinsvorsitzende Petra Küppers, die völlig verstört wirkt. Kurz zuvor hat sie die Leiche des Laubenbesitzers Oliver Mommsen entdeckt. Frau Küppers berichtet, dass es in letzter Zeit öfter Einbrüche in Harzer Laubenkolonien gegeben hat.

Klara Degen hat ihre Schwester Sylvia und Schwager Jörg auf ein Wellness-Wochenende geschickt, damit die beiden mal wieder Zeit für sich haben. Klara und ihre Nichte Lena machen sich indes einen schönen Abend. Damit ist es allerdings schnell vorbei, als ein Pizzabote ihnen nicht nur die falsche Pizza bringt, sondern kurz darauf tot im Hausflur zusammenbricht. Klara alarmiert umgehend ihren Chef, Hauptkommissar Kleinert.

Klara Degen, Sekretärin der Kripo Harz, möchte wieder in den eigenen vier Wänden leben und aus dem Haus ihrer Schwester Sylvia Wegener ausziehen, nicht zuletzt, weil Sylvia - nach dem Vorfall mit dem toten Pizzaboten im eigenen Hausflur - nun endgültig die Nase voll davon hat, dass Klara Leichen anzieht, wie die Motten das Licht.

Sekretärin Klara Degen ist spät dran und bittet ihren neuen Nachbarn und Chef, Hauptkommissar Kleinert, sie ausnahmsweise mit dem Auto ins Revier mitzunehmen. Doch der gemeinsamen Fahrt kommt ein dienstlicher Anruf dazwischen: Fritz Sommer, Besitzer der bedeutenden Harzer Firma Saatgut Süd, wurde tot in einer Abfüllanlage des Bio-Samens Harzer Blut auf dem Firmengelände entdeckt.

Maria und José Ribeiro sind mit ihrem Leben zufrieden. Während sie in einem wunderschönen Herrschaftssitz als Concierge arbeitet, ist er vorbildlicher Mitarbeiter einer Baufirma. Zusammen mit ihrer Familie leben sie im Erdgeschoss des erwähnten Pariser Herrschaftshauses. Freunde, Kollegen, Nachbarn - alle lieben die herzliche portugiesische Familie. Und trotz all der Gastfreundschaft, kommen Maria und José doch nicht so ganz von ihrem Heimweh los.

Jesper hängt Fie immer noch hinterher, aber sie hat inzwischen kein Interesse mehr an ihm. Mitzi drückt in einem Gespräch ihre Liebe zu Hitler aus. Madsen macht Geschäfte mit Morten. Frigh jagt eine junge Schauspielerin.

Aurland hat eine Radiodebatte in Kopenhagen. Frigh besucht Kitty erneut. Weyse kümmert sich um seinen vermeintlichen Sohn. Frau Aurland möchte indessen ein weiteres Baby. Amanda könnte zukünftig in der Werbung arbeiten.

Zwei Dienstmädchen sind krank geworden und niemand weiß, was die Ursache ist. Frau Frigh mag den netten Bauern Arne. Frau Aurland versucht, ihren Mann erneut zu verführen. Lydia mag Dr. Ploug, aber dieser ist an Olga interessiert.

Anne fürchtet die Reaktion ihres Vaters, wenn er von den Konsequenzen mit Jespers Rendezvous erfährt. Ein Wolkenbruch stellt das Hotel währenddessen gehörig auf den Kopf und bringt Enthüllungen sowie neue Beziehungen zum Vorschein.

Als der Sturm Kokholms Ernte zerstört, geht er bankrott und muss sich verabschieden. Frau Andersen, die versucht hat, ihm bei der Bank zu helfen, muss nun sogar das Hotel verkaufen. Wichtige Entscheidungen müssen getroffen werden.

Tom Avery führt ein angenehmes aber etwas langweiliges Leben im Wohlstand. Als Augenarzt im sonnigen Kalifornien besteht sein Alltag aus Arbeiten und Golfen. Sein Leben gerät jedoch aus seinen Fugen, als er erfährt, dass sein Sohn Daniel, von dem er sich seit dem Tod seiner Frau beziehungsweise Daniels Mutter entfremdet hat, bei einer Wanderung auf dem Jakobsweg in Spanien bei einem Unfall ums Leben gekommen ist.

Im Jahr 1973 eskaliert ein Banküberfall in Stockholm und wird zur Geiselnahme. Der Bankräuber Lars Nystrom fordert die sofortige Freilassung seines ehemaligen Komplizen, der im Gefängnis sitzt. Während die Verhandlungen langsam voranschreiten, entwickelt Nystrom eine unangenehme Bindung zu einer weiblichen Geisel, die eine Angestellte der Bank ist. Bianca Lind scheint die Gefühle ihres Entführers zu erwidern.

Das Filmmagazin stellt die wichtigsten Neustarts und Themen aus der Filmwelt vor. Das Magazin zeigt Porträts und Interviews mit Schauspielern und Regisseuren. Es werden die Tops und Flops kritisiert und von den spannendsten Festivals berichtet.

Drei Jahre nach seiner Hinrichtung wegen Mordes und seiner anschließenden Auferstehung flieht der Ex-Polizist Marlott aus der forensischen Psychiatrie, um Rache an Lord Daniel Hervey zu nehmen und einen Serienmörder zu fassen.

John Marlott nimmt eine neue Identität an und beginnt, als Abholer der Seuchenopfer zu arbeiten. Er ist überzeugt, dass jemand Lügen über die gehäuften Morde an Kirchenmännern verbreitet und ist fest entschlossen, die Wahrheit aufzudecken.

Während Marlott sich um die Opfer der tödlichen Pye-Street-Seuche kümmert, trifft er zufällig auf Billy Oates und hofft, dass ihn der Kinderfänger zu Lord Daniel Hervey führen kann. Derweil steigt befeuert von der Presse der Druck auf Peel, die Morde an Kirchenmännern aufzuklären.

Marlott begleitet Esther zur Party des mysteriösen Frederick Dipple und realisiert dort, dass er seine Verbündeten schützen muss, denn die geraten zunehmend in Gefahr. Als Peels Fähigkeiten immer mehr infrage gestellt werden, wird es immer unwahrscheinlicher, dass der König seinen Gesetzesentwurf absegnet.

Boz und Marlott erhalten neue Informationen, die sie zu einem scheinbar verlassenen Turm führen. Doch dort erwarten sie unaussprechliche Gefahren. Esther steht derweil vor einer schweren Entscheidung.
After Stalin's death, the countries of the Eastern Bloc hope for the end of communist dictatorship.

The gang finds out Wil Wheaton hosts a celebrity Dungeons and Dragons game involving William Shatner, Joe Manganiello, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar and Kevin Smith. Deception and betrayal are the path to make it to the one open seat.
Penny and Bernadette go to San Diego for a sales convention, leaving Howard in charge of Michael and Halley while they are away.
When their academic competitors charm America on a publicity tour, Sheldon and Amy try to get some Nobel laureates on their side.

Amy has a meltdown when she feels the pressure of what it would mean for women everywhere if she were to win a Nobel Prize. Koothrappali and Wolowitz try to relive the old days after Wolowitz buys a scooter that looks like the one he had years ago.
Raj publishes a paper that suggests he may have discovered alien life. Penny encourages Leonard to stand up for himself.
Barry Kripke finds proof that Dr Pemberton plagiarised his thesis in college. Should Sheldon and Amy turn their rival in or not?
Leonard is surprised when his mother Beverly comes to visit and is kind to him, until he finds out the real reason she's there.
Sheldon and Amy stay up late awaiting a phone call that could bring big news from the Nobel Committee: are their lives about to change?
Howard and Bernadette go away on a trip without their children, Leonard and Penny try to keep a secret, and Raj makes a new friend.

Two physicists learn how little they know about life when a beautiful woman comes into their lives. When Leonard and Sheldon meet Penny, Leonard is immediately interested in her, but Sheldon feels his friend is chasing a dream he'll never catch.
Sheldon and Leonard go to Penny's flat to drop off a package, but Sheldon can't believe how messy her flat is.
Leonard is depressed when he discovers that Penny is dating someone. As a result, Leonard actually summons up the courage to ask a woman out on a date.
